name: PyTorch 入门
description: PyTorch 框架入门，题目按学习顺序排列，取材自官方教程（Get Started / Learn the Basics / Beginner 60 分钟速览）与高星社区教程（Dive into Deep Learning、learn-pytorch 等）：先张量的形状、索引、步幅与视图/复制判定、广播与类型提升（dtype）账，再 autograd 求导与自定义 autograd.Function、前向/反向 Hook，然后组装 nn.Module、准备 Dataset 与 DataLoader、跑通 SGD 训练循环，最后处理 train/eval 模式、LR 调度器在循环里的位置、autocast 与 GradScaler、DistributedSampler 的单机索引账、参数冻结与优化器分组、state_dict 键重映射与断点续训。 nn.init 的 fan/gain/std/bound 记账：fan 的 receptive field 连乘、gain 查表与 bool param 拒收、kaiming 负斜率缺省 0 与 gain 缺省 0.01 的分流、xavier 的 fi+fo 分母，噪声显式入参的线性缩放壳。 DataLoader 单进程装配账：Sequential/Random/Batch 三层切批、DataLoader 每 epoch 的 _base_seed 抽取与 RandomSampler 无条件余数空消耗 quirk、有放回 32 分块、bool num_samples 放行、len 的 floor/ceil 双口径。 weights_only 白名单判定与 state_dict 键级账：zip 容器 data.pkl 的 GLOBAL 指令扫描、protocol-2 允许键表（含 range→xrange 拒绝 quirk 与 lambda 的 save 阶段 PicklingError）、2.6 起默认 True、load_state_dict 的 sorted missing/unexpected 差集。 RNG 可复现账：seed 的无符号 mod 2**64 包装与类型/越界双异常分类、fresh Generator 的 MT19937 缺省种子常数、get_state/set_state 的中流恢复与手写 fork 语义、dtype 进入消费路径与四原语顺序敏感消耗。
description_en: Introductory PyTorch, ordered as a learning path and drawn from the official tutorials (Get Started / Learn the Basics / Beginner 60-minute blitz) and high-star community tutorials (Dive into Deep Learning, learn-pytorch and similar): tensor shapes, indexing, the stride and view-or-copy layout ledger, broadcasting and the dtype type-promotion ledger first, then autograd, custom autograd.Function classes and forward/backward hooks, then assembling an nn.Module, preparing a Dataset and DataLoader and running an SGD training loop, and finally train/eval mode, where the LR scheduler belongs in the loop, autocast with GradScaler, the single-process index arithmetic of DistributedSampler, freezing parameters and optimizer groups, state_dict key remapping and resuming from a checkpoint. The nn.init fan/gain/std/bound ledger: receptive-field product in fan computation, the gain table with bool-param rejection, kaiming's negative-slope default of 0 versus gain's own 0.01 default, xavier's fi+fo denominator, and the explicit-noise linear-scaling shell. The single-process DataLoader assembly ledger: the Sequential/Random/Batch three-layer slicing, the per-epoch _base_seed draw plus RandomSampler's unconditional empty remainder draw quirk, the 32-block with-replacement path, bool num_samples being allowed, and the floor/ceil dual len semantics. The weights_only allowlist decision and state_dict key ledger: GLOBAL instruction scanning from the zip's data.pkl, the protocol-2 allowlist table (with the range→xrange rejection quirk and lambda's save-time PicklingError), the 2.6 default-to-True change, and load_state_dict's sorted missing/unexpected diffs. The RNG reproducibility ledger: unsigned mod-2**64 seed wrapping with dual error classification, the fresh generator's MT19937 default seed constant, mid-stream get_state/set_state restoration with hand-written fork semantics, dtype entering the consumption path, and order-sensitive four-primitive draining.

name: 算子合集
description: 手写神经网络核心算子：激活与归一化、卷积/池化/采样、注意力与位置编码、索引与形状变换、损失函数、优化器单步更新，以及 einsum、范数、logsumexp 等张量原语。
description_en: Hand-written neural network operators: activations and normalization, convolution/pooling/sampling, attention and positional encodings, indexing and shape transforms, loss functions, single optimizer steps, and tensor primitives such as einsum, norms and logsumexp.

name: AI 系统性能合集
description: 训练与推理系统的性能和显存账：激活/参数/KV Cache 显存估算、FLOPs 与 MFU、Roofline 与算术强度、算子融合的带宽收益、通信量与吞吐，以及缓存分配器、激活复用偏移规划和 offload 预取时间线等内存侧账本。
description_en: Performance and GPU-memory accounting for training and inference systems: activation/parameter/KV-cache estimates, FLOPs and MFU, Roofline and arithmetic intensity, the bandwidth win from operator fusion, communication volume and throughput, plus memory-side ledgers for the caching allocator, activation-reuse offset planning and offload prefetch timelines.

name: 分布式训练原语合集
description: 集合通信与多维并行：Broadcast / Gather / Scatter / All-Gather / Reduce-Scatter / All-Reduce / All-to-All / Reduce 与 Ring All-Reduce 逐步模拟，以及数据、张量、序列、专家、流水线并行的显存与通信账 —— ZeRO 分片与卸载、GPipe 气泡与 1F1B、Megatron TP、FSDP/DDP、rank 网格与通信组、弹性重映射、检查点与 Ring Attention。
description_en: Collective communication and multi-dimensional parallelism: Broadcast / Gather / Scatter / All-Gather / Reduce-Scatter / All-Reduce / All-to-All / Reduce with step-by-step Ring All-Reduce, plus the memory and communication accounting of data, tensor, sequence, expert and pipeline parallelism — ZeRO sharding and offload, GPipe bubble and 1F1B, Megatron TP, FSDP/DDP, rank grids and process groups, elastic remapping, checkpointing and Ring Attention.

name: 大模型结构合集
description: 大模型的构件与整模型装配：RMSNorm、RoPE、SwiGLU、GQA 因果注意力与 Decoder Layer，Qwen2 / Gemma2 全模型，DeepSeek MLA 及权重吸收后的解码，MTP 多 token 预测、YaRN/LongRoPE 长度外推、滑动窗口与全局掩码、softmax sink、Mixture-of-Depths、Squared-ReLU 注意力。
description_en: Building blocks and full-model assembly of modern LLMs: RMSNorm, RoPE, SwiGLU, GQA causal attention and the decoder layer, complete Qwen2 / Gemma2 models, DeepSeek MLA and weight-absorbed latent attention, MTP multi-token prediction, YaRN/LongRoPE length extrapolation, sliding-window vs global masking, attention sinks, Mixture-of-Depths and Squared-ReLU attention.

name: 优化器与调度合集
description: 优化器与学习率调度的单步账本：AdamW 与各类 Adam 变体（Lion、Adafactor、Muon、AdaBelief、RAdam、AdaBound、AdamP、NovoGrad、Yogi、Tiger、ADOPT、Cautious、Prodigy、Sophia-II、GaLore、MARS、AdaMuon、Lookahead 等）、梯度累积与裁剪、EMA，以及 warmup-cosine、WSD、OneCycle、ReduceLROnPlateau、SGDR、Noam 等调度器。SGD 全分支账：dampening / nesterov / maximize 三旋钮互相干扰、多步缓冲 carry-over 与构造期四道参数校验。Adam 全分支账：偏差修正的 t 只数真正更新过的步、eps 不加权地加在 sqrt(v)/sqrt(1-β₂ᵗ) 之后、amsgrad 滑动最大值的初始与更新时序、L2 衰减并进两个矩与 AdamW 解耦式的对照。
description_en: Single-step accounting for optimizers and learning-rate schedules: AdamW and its variants (Lion, Adafactor, Muon, AdaBelief, RAdam, AdaBound, AdamP, NovoGrad, Yogi, Tiger, ADOPT, Cautious, Prodigy, Sophia-II, GaLore, MARS, AdaMuon, Lookahead and friends), gradient accumulation, clipping and EMA, plus schedulers such as warmup-cosine, WSD, OneCycle, ReduceLROnPlateau, SGDR and inverse-sqrt Noam. The full SGD branch matrix: how dampening, nesterov and maximize interfere, multi-step buffer carry-over, and the four constructor checks. Adam's full branch matrix: bias correction that only counts real updates, an eps that is not rescaled, the amsgrad running maximum and its update order, and L2 decay entering both moments as the mirror image of AdamW.

name: 分词与数据整理合集
description: 分词与训练数据整理：BPE 合并规则的训练与编码、Unigram Viterbi 切分与路径采样、GPT-2 字节级预分词、WordPiece、特殊/Added token 模板与 ChatML 角色边界、UTF-8 偏移对齐与预算截断，以及批 Padding 与 attention_mask、序列打包、SFT 标签移位与逐轮损失权重、数据分片、近重复去重与文档内重复过滤和多数据集混采配额。
description_en: Tokenization and training-data preparation: training and applying BPE merges, Unigram Viterbi segmentation and path sampling, GPT-2 byte-level pre-tokenization, WordPiece, special/added-token templates and ChatML role boundaries, UTF-8 offset alignment and budgeted truncation, plus batch padding with attention_mask, sequence packing, SFT label shifting and per-turn loss weights, data sharding, near-duplicate dedup, intra-document repetition filtering and multi-dataset blending quotas.

name: 量化与低精度合集
description: 低精度量化与量化推理：对称/非对称、按通道/分组的 fake-quant 与 INT8 / FP8 / NF4 往返、Weight-Only GEMM，SmoothQuant、AWQ、LLM.int8()、QuaRot、GPTQ、SpQR、HQQ、BitNet、MX/BlockFP 等主流方案，以及离群值处理、误差补偿与缩放因子的搜索、位打包布局解包、KV Cache 量化，和部分二值化（PB-LLM）、格点量化（QuIP#）、按损失分配位宽（BAQ）、通道重排与分组（RPTQ / DuQuant）、双侧浮点 scale（AFPQ）与结构化残差二值（BiLLM）等低比特前沿方案。 FP4 E2M1 位级网格：0.5 是唯一非零次正规、最大 6 饱和且无 inf/NaN 码、RTNE 平局取尾数位 0，以及 MX 单级与 NVFP4 两级 scale 的乘积口径。 FP6 双子格式（E3M2 宽动态范围 / E2M3 高精度）按张量范围选择的量化往返，以及 6-bit 非字节对齐的 4-in-3 跨字节位拼接。 FP8 延迟缩放递推：滑动 amax 窗口、max/most_recent 两种归约、不可用 amax 与 sf 溢出两条回退分支。
description_en: Low-bit quantization and quantized inference: symmetric/asymmetric, per-channel and group-wise fake-quant with INT8 / FP8 / NF4 round-trips, weight-only GEMM, and mainstream schemes such as SmoothQuant, AWQ, LLM.int8(), QuaRot, GPTQ, SpQR, HQQ, BitNet and MX/BlockFP — plus outlier handling, error-compensation and scale searches, bit-packing layouts and unpacking, KV-cache quantization, and low-bit frontier schemes such as partial binarization (PB-LLM), lattice quantization (QuIP#), loss-driven bit allocation (BAQ), channel reordering and grouping (RPTQ / DuQuant), two-sided floating-point scales (AFPQ), and structural residual binarization (BiLLM). The FP4 E2M1 bit-level grid: 0.5 as the only non-zero subnormal, saturation at 6 with no inf/NaN codes, RTNE ties resolved by the mantissa bit, and the product form of MX single-level versus NVFP4 two-level scales. FP6 dual subformats (E3M2 for dynamic range, E2M3 for precision) selected by tensor range, plus the non-byte-aligned 4-in-3 cross-byte packing of 6-bit codes. FP8 delayed scaling recurrence: a sliding amax window, max versus most_recent reduction, and the two fallback branches for unusable amax and overflowing sf.

name: 采样策略合集
description: 解码期的 logits 后处理与采样：Top-k / Top-p / Min-p / Typical / Top-n-sigma / P-less / Epsilon / Adaptive-p / DRY / Mirostat v2 / XTC / Dripping，重复惩罚与 logit 偏置、对比搜索、多路分布混合，以及 llama.cpp 的完整采样管线阶段顺序。
description_en: Logit post-processing and sampling at decode time: Top-k / Top-p / Min-p / Typical / Top-n-sigma / P-less / Epsilon / Adaptive-p / DRY / Mirostat v2 / XTC / Dripping, repetition penalties and logit bias, contrastive search, mixture-of-samplers, and the full stage order of the llama.cpp sampling pipeline.

name: MoE 路由与专家并行合集
description: 混合专家的路由与执行：Top-k、Expert-Choice、Aux-free、Sinkhorn 等门控，Switch/CV/z-loss/序列级负载均衡损失，容量分派与 token dropping、共享专家与路由专家合成、负载 EMA 与死专家账，专家隐藏激活 dropout（激活后、第二投影前，inverted scaling、训练/推理不对称），以及 all-to-all 分派合并、分组矩阵乘的排序计划与 offsets 切分。
description_en: Routing and execution in mixture-of-experts: top-k, expert-choice, aux-free and Sinkhorn gating, Switch/CV/z-loss/sequence-level load-balancing losses, capacity dispatch with token dropping, shared versus routed expert mixing, load EMA and dead-expert accounting, expert-hidden dropout (after the activation, before the second projection, inverted scaling with train/inference asymmetry), plus all-to-all dispatch/combine and the sorted plan and offset slicing of grouped expert matmuls.

name: LLM 推理 Serving 合集
description: LLM 服务侧的调度与显存账：Continuous Batching 与 chunked prefill、PagedAttention 块分配与页表写时复制、前缀/KV Cache 命中与 LRU 驱逐、请求准入与抢占、SLO/EDF 与每步 token 预算、推测解码的名额分配、beam search 与受限解码（DFA 掩码、前缀 trie 增量复用、token 级索引编译与 NSA 分支调度）、multi-LoRA 热切换、cache-aware 粘性路由、TTFT/TPOT 时间线与 PD 分离的搬运账。
description_en: Scheduling and memory accounting on the LLM serving side: continuous batching and chunked prefill, PagedAttention block allocation with page-table copy-on-write, prefix/KV-cache hits and LRU eviction, request admission and preemption, SLO/EDF and per-step token budgets, speculative-decoding token quotas, beam search and constrained decoding (DFA masks, prefix-trie incremental reuse, token-level index compilation and NSA branch dispatch), multi-LoRA hot-swapping, cache-aware sticky routing, TTFT/TPOT timelines and the transfer ledger of prefill/decode disaggregation.

name: KV Cache 压缩合集
description: 推理 KV Cache 的压缩与驱逐：注意力打分（StreamingLLM sink、H2O、SnapKV、AdaKV、Observed/ExpectedAttention、FINCH、Q-Filter、R-KV、TriAttention、Q-Trust）、保留预算分配（PyramidKV、CAKE、层间背包、Palu 秩预算、Quest 页级选择、KVzip 全局阈值）、值合并与重旋转（WKVD、ZSMerge、HOMER、MorphKV、LoCoCo、KeyRerotation），以及稀疏模式搜索、低秩共享、张量积分解（TPA）与文档分段复用（KVLink）等通道/层/序列维度的策略。
description_en: Compression and eviction for the inference KV cache: attention-based scoring (StreamingLLM sinks, H2O, SnapKV, AdaKV, Observed/ExpectedAttention, FINCH, Q-Filter, R-KV, TriAttention, Q-Trust), retention-budget allocation (PyramidKV, CAKE, per-layer knapsacks, Palu rank budgets, Quest page selection, KVzip global thresholds), value merging and re-rotation (WKVD, ZSMerge, HOMER, MorphKV, LoCoCo, KeyRerotation), plus sparse-pattern search, low-rank sharing, tensor-product factorization (TPA), and document-segment reuse (KVLink) across channel/layer/sequence dimensions.

name: 对齐与训练目标合集
description: 对齐与后训练的目标函数：DPO / IPO / cDPO / ORPO / SimPO 等偏好损失与 DPO 的解析反向，PPO 与 GRPO 的截断代理目标、价值损失和自适应 KL 控制器，DAPO / GSPO / CISPO / RLOO / Dr.GRPO / REINFORCE++ 的优势估计与归一化次序，KTO、Bradley-Terry 奖励模型损失、GAE、label smoothing，以及 GKD / MiniLM 蒸馏。 782 to-gmpo-geom-mean：GMPO 的 token 级对数比几何平均优势（log 空间求和取指数）——MC 优势 base/grpo(std unbiased+1e-8)/drgrpo 三归一、符号翻转保守截断六路 pg-loss（noclip 内定 1000、seqclip 先 sum 再 clamp、without_norm 不除有效 token 数、wider 硬编码 0.67/1.49、else 标准 PPO-clip + masked aggregator）、batch>1 官方原生 RuntimeError、KL token 奖励 eos 注入的全 False 行 -1 负索引。 783 to-stepdpo-step-pairs：Step-DPO 的步级偏好对构造——错误步定位解析（decision 段 [-1] 切取 + step_num 三段提取链 + Step {n}: 前缀/续写切分的全局 replace 怪癖）、首步截断配对（identifier 分组、split("\nStep ") 首步、chosen 首步去重而 rejected 不去重）、筛选门控（diagram/asy 门、严格 > 同题配额且增量先于分片/visited、先保存再截断）。 785 to-opd-reverse-kl：OPD 反向 KL 在线蒸馏账（teacher 对 student 实际轨迹的整段 logprob 从 len(prompt) 切片 + 长度/None 双校验；右移 datum 的 input 吃 completion[:-1] / target 吃完整 completion 不对称与 float32 契约；step 批账的逐 token reverse_kl 差与 −coef advantage、token 粒度统计、空 datums RuntimeError；IDT 交替调度的周期元组、max 周期数 resolve、任务各自 step 下标回绕取批）。
description_en: Objective functions for alignment and post-training: preference losses such as DPO / IPO / cDPO / ORPO / SimPO with the analytic backward of DPO, the clipped surrogate, value loss and adaptive KL controller of PPO and GRPO, the advantage estimators and normalization order of DAPO / GSPO / CISPO / RLOO / Dr.GRPO / REINFORCE++, KTO, the Bradley-Terry reward-model loss, GAE and label smoothing, plus GKD / MiniLM distillation. 782 to-gmpo-geom-mean: GMPO's geometric mean over token-level log ratios (log-space sum, then exponentiate) — MC advantages with base/grpo(std unbiased+1e-8)/drgrpo normalizations, sign-flip conservative clipping across six pg-loss branches (noclip fixed at 1000, seqclip sums before clamping, without_norm skips the valid-token division, wider's hardcoded 0.67/1.49, else standard PPO-clip with masked aggregator), the official native batch>1 RuntimeError, and the all-False-row -1 negative index in KL token reward eos injection. 783 to-stepdpo-step-pairs: Step-DPO's step-level preference pair construction — error-step location parsing (the decision segment's [-1] extraction + the step_num three-stage chain + the global-replace quirk of the Step {n}: prefix/continuation split), first-error-step truncated pairing (identifier grouping, split("\nStep ") first steps, chosen-first-step dedup while rejected is not deduped), and filtering gates (the diagram/asy gate, the strict > per-question quota whose increment precedes sharding/visited, save-then-cut). 785 to-opd-reverse-kl: OPD's reverse-KL on-policy distillation accounting (the teacher's whole-sequence logprobs of the student's actual rollout sliced from len(prompt) with dual length/None validation; the right-shift datum's asymmetry of input taking completion[:-1] vs target taking the full completion plus the float32 contract; the step batch ledger's per-token reverse_kl difference and -coef advantage, token-granular statistics, RuntimeError on empty datums; the IDT schedule's cycle tuple, max-cycle resolve, and per-task step-index wrap-around batching).

name: 推测解码合集
description: 推测解码的草稿生成与验证：Medusa 多头候选树、Sequoia 多分支采样与最优草稿树 DP、EAGLE-2 动态重排与剪枝、SpecInfer 通用 token-tree 并行验证、LayerSkip 逐层早退，typical acceptance 与逐 token 接受判据、Lookahead Jacobi n-gram 与 REST/后缀自动机草稿、tree attention 掩码构造，以及接受率到加速比的解析账。
description_en: Draft generation and verification in speculative decoding: Medusa multi-head candidate trees, Sequoia multi-branch sampling and optimal draft-tree DP, EAGLE-2 dynamic re-ranking and pruning, SpecInfer generic token-tree parallel verification, LayerSkip early-exit drafts, typical acceptance and per-token acceptance tests, Lookahead Jacobi n-grams and REST/suffix-automaton drafting, tree-attention mask construction, and the analytic acceptance-rate-to-speedup ledger.

name: 参数高效微调合集
description: 参数高效微调的旁路模块：LoRA 前向、权重合并与参数量账，IA³、Adapter、DoRA、BitFit、Prompt/Prefix-Tuning，LoHa / LoKr / AdaLoRA / VeRA / UniLoRA / VB-LoRA / C3A / WaveFT / FourierFT 等重参数化，OFT / BOFT / HRA / RoAD 等正交与旋转适配，DARE+TIES 合并与 GLoRA 逆解，GraLoRA 子块低秩、MiSS 分片共享、TinyLoRA 冻结 SVD 因子、Lily 跨层专家互联、AdaMSS 多子空间散射、BEFT 旁路偏置、FRoD 跨层共享旋转基上的对角加稀疏增量、PVeRA 在共享随机投影上的概率重参数化、X-LoRA 的缩放分类器驱动的 MoE 式 LoRA 混合调度、Cartridge 直接参数化的 KV 前缀适配器、EVA 解释方差驱动的跨层全局秩预算分配、LoRA-SB 符号梯度估计的 SVD 初始化、LoRA-GA 梯度近似的四方向四尺度初始化与 offset 吸收、CorDA 协方差定向分解的 KPA/IPA 适配、Astra 输出激活协方差尾特征向量初始化（eigh 升序取尾、A=VᵀW 冻结残差）、VeLoRA 秩 1 子令牌激活压缩（前向投影标量、反向粗重建，A 梯度走重建激活）、BD-LoRA 张量并行服务的块对角因子（紧凑分片 einsum 前向、block_diag 展开合并）、Arrow 令牌级 LoRA 路由（幂迭代原型、top-k 温度 softmax、非选中系数严格置零）、GenKnowSub 通用知识减除（GK 因子平均就地减入任务因子、三态门控）、PEANuT 权重感知 tweaker（A 以 out_features 为 fan_in、depth 残差反序、B 零初始化）、ShadowPEFT 影子状态注入（差值低秩瓶颈、GRU 风格门控更新）、MonteCLoRA 贝叶斯重参数化（对角收缩协方差、专家权重 sigmoid 归一）、AdaptionPrompt 门控注意力分支（normal_ prompt、零门控、GQA repeat_interleave、softmax fp32 上转换）、CPT 上下文感知提示微调（%4 掩码族、ε 球投影只收缩不放大、decay 组倒序加权）、Polytropon 技能清单路由（sigmoid 归一化非 softmax、MHR 头切分、1/r 缩放）、PSOFT 因子间 Cayley 正交旋转（反对称参数化、Neumann 级数、ΔW=scaling·B(R−I)A）、OSF 正交子空间微调（自适应 SVD 冻结高秩子空间、梯度正交投影）、DeFT 解耦子空间替换微调（子空间替换 (I−P_proj)W+Q_P·R、relu/qr 两种投影、恒等初始化、merge 因子缓存）、add_weighted_adapter 加权 Adapter 合并（单源强制 linear、rank 三族规则、√拆分符号单侧、SVD 奇异值吸收进 B、svd_clamp 分位数截断），以及 QLoRA、多 Adapter 热切换与 Adapter 池共享。 另有 LN-Tuning：目标 LayerNorm 整层 deepcopy 成可训练副本、merge/unmerge 以交换 base_layer 与副本实现（无数值合并、safe_merge 无效、一次仅 1 个 adapter）、forward 五分支路由与 _unloading_checks 的 key 过滤账。
description_en: Bypass modules for parameter-efficient fine-tuning: LoRA forward, weight merging and parameter counts, IA³, adapters, DoRA, BitFit and prompt/prefix tuning, re-parameterizations such as LoHa / LoKr / AdaLoRA / VeRA / UniLoRA / VB-LoRA / C3A / WaveFT / FourierFT, orthogonal and rotation adapters like OFT / BOFT / HRA / RoAD, DARE+TIES merging and the exact GLoRA inverse, the GraLoRA granular sub-block, the MiSS shard-sharing structure, TinyLoRA frozen SVD factors, Lily cross-layer experts and the AdaMSS multi-subspace scatter, the BEFT bypass bias, FRoD's diagonal-plus-sparse deltas on a cross-layer shared rotation, PVeRA's probabilistic reparameterization over shared random projections, X-LoRA's scaling-classifier-driven MoE-style mixing of LoRA experts, Cartridge's directly parameterized KV-prefix adapter, EVA's explained-variance-driven global rank budget allocation across layers, LoRA-SB's sign-estimated gradient SVD initialization, LoRA-GA's gradient-approximation initialization with four directions, four scales and offset absorption, CorDA's covariance-oriented decomposition with KPA/IPA adapters, Astra's tail-eigenvector initialization from output activation covariance (ascending eigh, A=VᵀW with frozen residual), VeLoRA's rank-1 sub-token activation compression (forward scalar projection, backward coarse rebuild with only grad_A through the reconstruction), BD-LoRA's block-diagonal factors for tensor-parallel serving (compact shard einsum forward, block_diag expanded merge), Arrow's token-wise LoRA routing (power-iteration prototypes, top-k temperature softmax, strictly-zeroed unselected coefficients), GenKnowSub's general-knowledge subtraction (GK factor averaging folded into task factors, three-state gating), PEANuT's weight-aware tweaker (A fanned on out_features, reversed-order depth residual, zero-init B), ShadowPEFT's shadow-state injection (difference low-rank bottleneck, GRU-style gated update), MonteCLoRA's Bayesian reparameterization (shrunk diagonal covariance, sigmoid-normalized expert weights), AdaptionPrompt's gated attention branch (normal prompt, zero gate, GQA repeat_interleave, fp32 softmax upcast), CPT's context-aware prompt tuning (%4 mask family, shrink-only epsilon-ball projection, reverse-order decay groups), Polytropon's skill-inventory routing (sigmoid normalization, not softmax; MHR split routing; 1/r scaling), PSOFT's Cayley orthogonal rotation between SVD factors (skew-symmetric parametrization, Neumann series, ΔW = scaling·B(R−I)A), OSF's orthogonal subspace fine-tuning (adaptive SVD frozen high-rank subspace, orthogonal gradient projection), DeFT's decoupled subspace-replacement fine-tuning (subspace replacement (I−P_proj)W+Q_P·R, relu/qr projections, identity init, merge factor caching), add_weighted_adapter weighted adapter merging (single-source forces linear, three rank-rule families, sqrt split with one-sided sign, singular values absorbed into B, svd_clamp quantile clipping), plus QLoRA, multi-adapter hot swapping and shared adapter pools. Also LN-Tuning: the target LayerNorm is deep-copied whole into a trainable replica, merge/unmerge swap base_layer with the replica (no numeric merge, safe_merge has no effect, one adapter at a time), the five-branch forward router, and the key-filtering ledger of _unloading_checks.

name: 扩散模型合集
description: 扩散与流匹配模型的采样与训练基建：正弦时间步嵌入与线性/余弦噪声调度，DDPM 前向加噪与反向后验，DDIM 及其逆向一步，ε / x₀ / v 预测互转，Euler / DPM-Solver(++) / UniPC / LCM / EDM 预条件 / Flow Matching 等求解器，CFG 与 APG / TCFG / PAG / FDG / AutoGuidance 等引导算子，zero-terminal-SNR、Min-SNR、SD3 时间步密度与分辨率分桶等训练侧，以及 RePaint / SDEdit / 熵界 / AMUS / VQ-Diffusion / BlockRefinement 等掩码与离散扩散调度。 另有 KDPM2：基础 σ 表经 log-空间 lerp 造出相邻 σ 的几何平均中点，再 repeat_interleave 成长度 2N+2 的交错表；每个逻辑步两次模型调用——首调在 σ 上走欧拉半步到中点、只暂存原样本，次调在中点上重估导数（分母是中点）、dt 却是整步长且从暂存样本出发，首调导数直接丢弃；末逻辑步只有首调，中点表尾部为 0 一步落到 x₀。 另有 KDPM2-Ancestral：同一两调用骨架上的噪声拆分——up²+down²=σ_next² 的方差守恒把确定性步长拆成「确定性 σ→σ_down」与「噪声 σ_up」，中点改插在 σ 与 σ_down 之间、次调 dt = σ_down − σ（不是整步长）、落地注入 noise·σ_up；interpol 表数学上恒等于 σ_next（√(σ·down) 的冗余构造），torch 的 lerp(有限, −inf) = nan 使 `[-2:]=0` 清场成两格刚需，而 down 的 √(σ_next²−σ_up²) 在 σ≫σ_next 时是官方真实的灾难性消去点。 另有 SA-Solver：随机 Adams-Bashforth 预估 + Adams-Moulton 校正的单调用状态机——corrector 消费的三样东西（阶数、样本、噪声）全部来自上一步，predictor 全用本轮的；两侧历史差一拍（corrector 用移位前 history+x0、predictor 用移位后），M = max(predictor_order, corrector_order−1) 的 −1 正是给 corrector 的 x0 腾位；warmup 双 cap 使末步 predictor 必降 1 阶、None 头永不被读；两套 order-2 修正是不同公式（分母一个是相邻 λ 差、一个含 h），而 λ ≡ −log σ、e^λ ≡ 1/σ 的 VE 恒等式让 1 阶系数有闭式 1/σ_t − 1/σ_s0。 另有 LMS-Discrete：线性多步法把导数历史攒起来，用过最近若干个 σ 数据点的 Lagrange 插值多项式在 σ 空间上积分外推——系数即 Lagrange 基的区间积分（官方 scipy.integrate.quad 现算，σ 表递减使区间反向、单系数可正可负但和恒为区间长度），历史超长 pop 头部；order_used = min(step_index+1, order) 使首步退化为欧拉（系数 = σ1 − σ0），order=1 全程欧拉；coeff[0] 配最新导数。 另有 PLMS（PNDM 的 skip_prk_steps 全程路径，SD 默认）：ets 历史（截断 [-3:] + append，唯独 counter 1 不 append）驱动 Adams-Bashforth 阶梯——恒等/两点梯形/2 阶/3 阶/4 阶按 ets 长度 1→2→3→4 逐级爬升；counter 1 从 counter 0 暂存的 cur_sample 在 (t+δ, t) 上重走整步（前两步 plms ≡ 一次梯形步）；落地 formula(9)，prev_timestep < 0 取表头 ᾱ(0)=1−β₀<1（ᾱ(0)=1 会零化分母），t=prev 时恒等退化 prev≡sample。 759 diff-cosine-dpmsolver-sde-step：CosineDPMSolverMultistep 把 DPMSolver 多步法搬进 EDM/VE 约定——α≡1 使 λ≡−log σ、e^{−h}=σ_t/σ_s0 给出 1 阶系数 (σ_t/σ_s0)² 的闭式；convert 先过 c_skip/c_out 的 EDM 预条件（v_prediction 负号）；两条 update 各带 σ_t·√(1−e^{−2h})·noise 的 SDE 噪声项；末步降阶是 euler_at_final / lower_order_final∧N<15 / final_sigmas_type=="zero" 三选一的或条件，zero 收尾使末步 σ_t=0、h=+∞、prev 恒等 x0（官方永远不让二阶碰 σ_t=0）。 760 diff-wuerstchen-ddpm-step：DDPMWuerstchen 无离散 β 表——ᾱ 是连续 t∈[0,1] 的解析 cosine 函数（s offset、除 _init_alpha_cumprod 归一化、clamp [0.0001,0.9999]），经 scaler 幂变换扭曲时间轴（>1 推向高噪端）；prev_t 在 set_timesteps 表上 argmin 最近邻取下一位（官方只用 timestep[0] 定位）；DDPM 后验在 prev_t 精确为 0 时门控掉噪声项（DDIM 式确定性收尾），ᾱ 相等时退化为恒等步。 761 diff-scm-trigflow-step：sCM/Sana-Sprint 的 trigflow 一致性步——timestep 是角度 θ=arctan(σ/σ_data)∈[0,π/2]，一致性步「跳回数据端再重加噪」：pred_x0=cos(s)·x−sin(s)·F、prev=cos(t)·pred_x0+sin(t)·σ_data·noise；末步 t=0 时 sin(t)=0 噪声项自然消失（单步采样 prev≡x0，无需显式门控），noise 非 None 但 t=0 时 prev 与噪声取值无关（官方 randn 采样了但被乘零）。 762 diff-tcd-gamma-two-segment-step：TCD 的 gamma 两段式一致性步——中间噪声级 s=floor((1−eta)·prev_t)，先 x_s=√ᾱ_s·x0+√(1−ᾱ_s)·ε 跳到 s（同一个 ε），再 prev=√(ᾱ_prev/ᾱ_s)·x_s+√(1−ᾱ_prev/ᾱ_s)·noise 加噪到 prev；末步或 eta=0 时 prev=x_s；三参数化各自推导 x0/ε 但两段公式共用；表尾越界 prev_t 取 0（官方 final_alpha 分支死代码）。 763 diff-taylorseer-cache-step：TaylorSeer 缓存步——门控三条件（warmup 步 < before、(step−before−1)%interval==0 的对齐步、cooldown 步 ≥ after）决定 compute/predict；compute 步做 delta 归一差分递推 f[j+1]=(f[j]_new−f[j]_prev)/delta（首更新只存 order0、形状变化重启、delta==0 报错），predict 步做泰勒外推 Σ offset^j/j!·f[j]；warmup 步也要更新因子（官方注释 caching not applied 但 factors updated）。 764 diff-fbcache-residual-gate-step：First Block Cache 残差门控——首块永远真实执行，diff = absmean(residual−prev)/absmean(prev) 与 threshold 比较（首步或 diff>threshold 时 compute）；compute 步缓存三项（head_output/head_residual/tail_residuals=tail−head_output），cache 步输出 = 缓存尾残差 + 当前首块输出且 state 全部保持旧值（stale 比较，参照冻结在上次 compute）；残差变小（负差值）时 abs 不可省。 765 diff-magcache-accumulated-error-step：MagCache 累积误差门控——retention_step=int(retention_ratio·N+0.5) 四舍五入出保留窗（窗内强制 compute），窗外先累积后判定：ratio 连乘 mag_ratios[step]（越界回退 1.0）、steps+1、err += |1−ratio|（是 |1−Πscale| 的累加非单步），previous_residual 非 None ∧ err≤threshold ∧ steps≤max_skip 三条件齐才 skip；skip 步输出 = hidden + 上次 compute 的残差、累积器保留不重置，compute 分支才重置为初值并缓存尾残差；mag_ratios 长度不等时 nearest_interp 最近邻索引插值（round 银行家舍入）。 766 diff-sea-cache-gate-step：SeaCache 频域指示器门控——原始视觉隐张量 (C,T,H,W) movedim 后对空间三维做 FFT，每轴 Wiener 增益 (1−σ)·cp/((1−σ)²·cp+σ²+1e-16)（cp=1/(|f|^p+1e-16)）三轴连乘再均值归一，ifftn 取实部为指示器；相邻步指示器的累积相对 L1（distance=mean|cur−prev|/(mean|prev|+1e-16)，candidate=累加）≥ threshold 即 compute（>= 恰等也算），retention 窗/cache_end 窗/首观测/连续缓存上限/形状不符强制 compute，步非相邻先整条轨迹重置；compute 步记录残差并截断 history、归零累积，skip 步输出 = gen_input + 最近残差（order=1 且两条不同步记录时按步距线性外推），无 history 或残差形状不符两条 fail-open compute 且累积归零。 767 diff-pab-attention-broadcast-step：PAB 注意力广播——层名 re.search 任意 identifier 命中按 spatial>temporal>cross 优先级分发（spatial/temporal 要求非 cross、cross 要求 is_cross，官方默认 spatial_ids 的 "blocks" 会先吞掉 temporal 层名），三类各有 block_skip_range 与时间步开区间 (lo,hi)，全 None 时回退 spatial=2；门控 within=lo<t<hi（严格）内且 iteration%N≠0 且 cache 非 None 才广播（输出=上次缓存，cache 每步更新、iteration 每步 +1），未匹配层不挂 hook 恒 compute。 768 diff-fastercache-attention-extrap-step：FasterCache 注意力外推——开区间内 iteration%N≠0 初判跳过，再经 batch 失配复核（cache 只存 conditional 半批，整批前向必须真算；蒸馏模型豁免），广播输出是最近两次条件输出的线性外推 t_1+(t_1−t_2)·weight（cache 条目若为整批先切后半 [batch:]），缓存双槽滚动 [旧[1], 新条件输出]、整批写入时 chunk 取后半、首步 [c,c]；区间端点连条件半批也恒 compute。 769 diff-fastercache-cfg-freq-approx-step：FasterCache denoiser 侧 CFG-Cache——开区间内 iteration%N≠0 且非蒸馏才跳过 uncond 分支（skip 步输入是条件半批、batch×2==记录值、delta 已建立三前置），整批步 chunk 半批各自 BCFHW→(B*F,C,H,W) 后 fft2+fftshift按圆形低频掩码（radius=min(H,W)//5、中心 (W//2,H//2)、含边界）拆低/高频谱，delta=uncond−cond 存入 state；skip 步用 cond 的谱 + 缩放后 delta 重建 uncond 频谱（delta←delta×alpha 的**累积**缩放，各自更新开区间内生效、区间外 1.0），real(ifft2(ifftshift)) 还原后 cat 回整批；整批步重算覆盖 delta。官方 iteration>0 死代码剔除，.real 被末尾 .to(float) 的复数转换子sumed（等价剔除）。 832 diff-dpmsolver-inverse-multistep：DPMSolverMultistep 反演调度器在递增 σ 表下的多步更新账——VP/flow 两条 σ→(α,σ_t) 约定与 λ/h/h₀/h₁、convert_model_output 的 x0_pred/ε 换算（flow_prediction 用原始 σ）、一/二/三阶 midpoint/heun 与 D1/D2 系数、降阶标志（无 final_sigmas_type=="zero" 项）、历史移位与 warmup 计数器状态机；官方源码逐字对拍。
description_en: The sampling and training infrastructure of diffusion and flow-matching models: sinusoidal timestep embeddings and linear/cosine noise schedules, DDPM forward noising and reverse posterior steps, DDIM and its inverse, conversions between ε / x₀ / v predictions, solvers such as Euler / DPM-Solver(++) / UniPC / LCM / EDM preconditioning / Flow Matching, CFG and guidance operators like APG / TCFG / PAG / FDG / AutoGuidance, training-side pieces such as zero-terminal-SNR, Min-SNR, SD3 timestep densities and resolution bucketing, and masked or discrete schedulers such as RePaint / SDEdit / entropy-bound / AMUS / VQ-Diffusion / BlockRefinement. Also KDPM2: the base sigma table yields geometric-mean midpoints of adjacent sigmas via a log-space lerp, then repeat_interleave builds interleaved tables of length 2N+2; each logical step takes two model calls — the first walks an Euler half-step from sigma to the midpoint and stores only the original sample, the second re-evaluates the derivative at the midpoint (denominator is the midpoint) but with dt spanning the full step and departing from the stored sample, the first derivative discarded; the last logical step has only the first call, and the zero tail of the midpoint table lands straight on x0. Also KDPM2-Ancestral: noise splitting on the same two-call skeleton — the variance conservation up^2+down^2=sigma_next^2 splits the deterministic step into the deterministic sigma->sigma_down part plus a noise part sigma_up, the midpoint is interpolated between sigma and sigma_down, the second call's dt is sigma_down - sigma (not the full step) and noise*sigma_up is injected on landing; the interpol table equals sigma_next in exact math (a redundant construction via sqrt(sigma*down)), torch's lerp(finite, -inf) = nan makes the [-2:]=0 clearing a two-slot necessity, and down = sqrt(sigma_next^2 - sigma_up^2) is a real upstream catastrophic-cancellation point when sigma >> sigma_next. Another SA-Solver entry: the single-call state machine of a stochastic Adams-Bashforth predictor plus an Adams-Moulton corrector — the three things the corrector consumes (order, sample, noise) all come from the previous call, while the predictor uses only this call's; the two sides' histories differ by one beat (corrector: pre-shift history + x0, predictor: post-shift), and the -1 in M = max(predictor_order, corrector_order-1) exists precisely to make room for the corrector's x0; the twin warmup caps force the final step's predictor down to order 1 and keep the None head unread; the two order-2 corrections are different formulas (one denominator is an adjacent lambda gap, the other contains h), and the VE identity lambda = -log sigma, e^lambda = 1/sigma gives order-1 coefficients the closed form 1/sigma_t - 1/sigma_s0. Another LMS-Discrete entry: the linear multistep method accumulates derivative history and extrapolates by integrating, over sigma-space, the Lagrange polynomial through the most recent sigma data points — the coefficients are interval integrals of Lagrange bases (officially computed on the fly with scipy.integrate.quad; the decreasing sigma table reverses the interval, so single coefficients may be positive or negative while their sum is constantly the interval length), and history pops from the head when over the cap; order_used = min(step_index+1, order) makes the first step degenerate to Euler (coefficient = sigma_1 - sigma_0), and order=1 is Euler all the way; coeff[0] pairs with the newest derivative. Another PLMS entry (PNDM's skip_prk_steps full path, SD's default): the ets history (truncate [-3:] + append, except counter 1 which does not append) drives an Adams-Bashforth ladder — identity / two-point trapezoid / 2nd / 3rd / 4th order climbing with ets length 1→2→3→4; counter 1 re-walks a full step over (t+delta, t) from the cur_sample stashed at counter 0 (the first two plms steps = one trapezoid step); landing is formula(9), with prev_timestep < 0 taking the table head ᾱ(0)=1-beta_0<1 (ᾱ(0)=1 would zero the denominator), and the t=prev case degenerates to the identity prev≡sample. 759 diff-cosine-dpmsolver-sde-step: CosineDPMSolverMultistep ports DPMSolver multistep to the EDM/VE convention — α≡1 gives λ≡−log σ and e^{−h}=σ_t/σ_s0, a closed form (σ_t/σ_s0)² for the first-order coefficient; convert applies the c_skip/c_out EDM preconditioner first (negative sign for v_prediction); both updates carry the SDE noise term σ_t·√(1−e^{−2h})·noise; final-step lowering is the OR of euler_at_final / lower_order_final∧N<15 / final_sigmas_type=="zero", and a zero tail makes the final step σ_t=0, h=+∞, prev≡x0 (the official code never lets second order touch σ_t=0). 760 diff-wuerstchen-ddpm-step: DDPMWuerstchen has no discrete beta table — ᾱ is an analytic cosine function of continuous t∈[0,1] (s offset, normalized by _init_alpha_cumprod, clamped to [0.0001,0.9999]) warped by a scaler power transform (>1 pushes toward the noisy end); prev_t is the argmin-nearest-neighbor successor on the set_timesteps table (officially located by timestep[0] only); the DDPM posterior gates out the noise term when prev_t is exactly 0 (DDIM-style deterministic finish), degenerating to an identity step when ᾱ is equal. 761 diff-scm-trigflow-step: the sCM/Sana-Sprint trigflow consistency step — timestep is the angle θ=arctan(σ/σ_data)∈[0,π/2], and the step "jumps back to the data end then re-noises": pred_x0=cos(s)·x−sin(s)·F, prev=cos(t)·pred_x0+sin(t)·σ_data·noise; when the terminal t=0, sin(t)=0 lets the noise term vanish naturally (one-step sampling prev≡x0, no explicit gate), and with noise not None but t=0, prev is independent of the noise value (officially randn is sampled but multiplied by zero). 762 diff-tcd-gamma-two-segment-step: TCD's gamma two-segment consistency step — intermediate level s=floor((1−eta)·prev_t), first jump x_s=√ᾱ_s·x0+√(1−ᾱ_s)·ε (same ε), then prev=√(ᾱ_prev/ᾱ_s)·x_s+√(1−ᾱ_prev/ᾱ_s)·noise; final step or eta=0 gives prev=x_s; the three parameterizations derive x0/ε separately but share the two segment formulas; table overflow takes prev_t=0 (the official final_alpha branch is dead code). 763 diff-taylorseer-cache-step: the TaylorSeer cache step — three gate conditions (warmup steps < before, aligned steps with (step−before−1)%interval==0, cooldown steps ≥ after) decide compute/predict; compute steps run the delta-normalized divided-difference recursion f[j+1]=(f[j]_new−f[j]_prev)/delta (first update stores order0 only, shape changes restart, delta==0 raises), predict steps extrapolate Σ offset^j/j!·f[j]; warmup steps also update factors (official comment: caching not applied but factors updated). 764 diff-fbcache-residual-gate-step: the First Block Cache residual gate — the head block always really runs, diff = absmean(residual−prev)/absmean(prev) compared against threshold (compute on the first step or diff>threshold); compute steps cache three entries (head_output/head_residual/tail_residuals=tail−head_output), cache steps output cached tail residual + current head output and keep the entire state stale (frozen at the last compute); abs cannot be dropped when the residual shrinks (negative differences). 765 diff-magcache-accumulated-error-step: the MagCache accumulated-error gate — retention_step = int(retention_ratio·N+0.5) rounds half-up into a retention window (forced compute inside), and outside it the step accumulates first and decides second: ratio multiplies mag_ratios[step] (out-of-range falls back to 1.0), steps+1, err += |1−ratio| (an accumulation of |1−Πscale|, not per-step terms); skip requires previous_residual non-None ∧ err≤threshold ∧ steps≤max_skip; skip steps output hidden + the last compute's residual and keep the accumulators unreset, while only the compute branch resets to the initial values and caches the tail residual; when mag_ratios length differs, nearest_interp does nearest-neighbour index interpolation (round's banker's rounding). 766 diff-sea-cache-gate-step: the SeaCache spectral-indicator gate — the raw vision latent (C,T,H,W) is moved then FFT'd over the three spatial axes, each axis multiplied by the Wiener gain (1−σ)·cp/((1−σ)²·cp+σ²+1e-16) (cp=1/(|f|^p+1e-16)), the three gains multiply and are mean-normalized, and ifftn's real part becomes the indicator; the accumulated relative L1 of the indicator across adjacent steps (distance = mean|cur−prev|/(mean|prev|+1e-16), candidate = accumulated sum) computing once ≥ threshold (exact equality included), with the retention window/cache-end window/first observation/consecutive-cache cap/shape mismatch forcing compute and a non-adjacent step resetting the whole trajectory first; compute steps record the residual, truncate history and zero the accumulation, skip steps output gen_input + the latest residual (with order=1 and two distinct-step records, linearly extrapolated by step gap), and empty-history or residual-shape mismatch are two fail-open compute channels that zero the accumulation. 767 diff-pab-attention-broadcast-step: PAB attention broadcast — the layer name is matched by re.search against any identifier with spatial>temporal>cross priority (spatial/temporal require non-cross, cross requires is_cross; the official default spatial_ids' "blocks" pre-empts temporal layer names), each class has its block_skip_range and open timestep interval (lo,hi), and all-None falls back to spatial=2; the gate broadcasts only when within lo<t<hi (strict) with iteration%N≠0 and a non-None cache (output = the last cache, cache updated every step, iteration +1 every step), while unmatched layers get no hook and always compute. 768 diff-fastercache-attention-extrap-step: the FasterCache attention extrapolation — inside the open interval a skip is first proposed when iteration%N≠0, then rechecked by batch mismatch (the cache holds only conditional halves, so full-batch forwards must really run; distilled models are exempt), the broadcast output is the linear extrapolation t_1+(t_1−t_2)·weight of the two most recent conditional outputs (cache entries carrying a full batch are sliced to the latter half [batch:] first), the two-slot cache rolls as [old[1], new conditional output] with full-batch writes chunking the latter half and the first step [c,c]; interval endpoints always compute even for conditional-half calls. 769 diff-fastercache-cfg-freq-approx-step: the denoiser-side CFG-Cache of FasterCache — the uncond branch is skipped only inside the open interval when iteration%N≠0 and not distilled (skip-step preconditions: conditional-half input, batch×2==the recorded value, delta established); full-batch steps chunk the halves, map each BCFHW→(B*F,C,H,W), then fft2+fftshift and split low/high spectra by a circular low-frequency mask (radius=min(H,W)//5, center (W//2,H//2), inclusive boundary), storing delta=uncond−cond in state; skip steps rebuild the uncond spectrum from cond's spectrum plus the scaled delta (delta←delta×alpha is a **cumulative** scaling, effective inside each update open interval, 1.0 outside), restored via real(ifft2(ifftshift)) and cat-ed back to the full batch; full-batch steps recompute and overwrite the delta. The official iteration>0 dead code is excluded, and .real is subsumed by the trailing .to(float) complex conversion (equivalent, excluded). 832 diff-dpmsolver-inverse-multistep: the multistep update ledger of the DPMSolverMultistep inverse scheduler on an increasing sigma table - VP/flow sigma-to-(alpha,sigma_t) conventions and lambda/h/h_0/h_1, convert_model_output x0_pred/epsilon conversions (flow_prediction uses the raw sigma), first/second/third-order midpoint/heun and D1/D2 coefficients, lower-order flags (no final_sigmas_type=="zero" term), history shift and the warmup-counter state machine; verified verbatim against the official source.

name: 稀疏剪枝合集
description: 模型压缩中的剪枝与稀疏存储：全局与逐行幅值剪枝、2:4 及 N:M 半结构化剪枝、块结构与注意力头剪枝，Wanda / OWL / TRIM / SparseGPT 等打分与误差补偿，GSL 渐稀疏调度和动态稀疏训练的 drop–grow 与 STE 微调，以及 CSR / ELL / BSR 编码、元数据打包与存储字节账。 770 sparsity-slicegpt-rotate-slice：SliceGPT 正交旋转-切边——不置零不量化，用校准信号 H=Σxᵀx（mask==0 的 token 置零、对角 damp=0.01·mean(diag) 防退化）的 eigh 特征向量做正交旋转（升序分解后按特征值降序重排列），切掉尾部低能量维度整体降秩：W_qkv 右乘 Q_in 切列、W_o/W_2 左乘 Q.T 切行（偏置同旋转同切）、W_1 右乘 Q_mid 切列（MLP 输入维 ≡ attn 输出维），双 shortcut 链attn_shortcut=Q_in.T[:ain]@Q_mid[:,:aout]、mlp_shortcut=(Q_mid.T[:aout]@Q_out)[:,:mout]（float32 matmul）把被切开的相邻块链回；damping 只加对角（可由返回特征值观测），掩码置零前 clone 纯函数式。测试谱非退化（相邻特征值 gap>1e-3）是判题前提，eigh 作共享原语、H 构造与记账管线独立复算。 771 sparsity-losparse-decompose：LoSparse 低秩+结构化稀疏分解——W ≈ L@R + S：svd(full_matrices=False) 后parameter_ratio 优先给 k=ceil(pr·H·W/(H+W))（参数量预算，覆盖 rank_ratio=ceil(rank·ratio)），√diag(S) 拆分使 L=U@√diag[:,选列]、R=√diag[选行,:]@Vh 参数均衡且 L@R 恰为所选（max 取头 k/min 取尾 k）奇异三元组重构；残差 S=W−LR 经 neuron_mask 模拟训练置零后按行和 nonzero 提幸存神经元，前向 x@R.T@L.T 加全量残差项（未剪枝）或 scatter(x@sparse_pruned.T, nonzero_idx)（剪枝后）+bias；正比例经 ceil 恒 ≥1 只查 k 上界，秩亏计数 count_nonzero(S) 只有精确零行才产生精确 0 奇异值。与 GEAR（残差幅度 top-k 元素）划界：LoSparse 是行级结构化剪枝。 772 sparsity-llmbarber-mask-rebuild：LLM-Barber 稀疏掩码重建——在现有稀疏模式上做交换而非回稠密重剪：metric 三选（WD=|W|·√scaler、W、D）算重要性，find_threshold 把被剪位（growth，降序）与存活位（prune，升序）前 min_len 项按位配对、严格 > 计数得 recons_num，idx=int(recons_num·threshold) 取双阈值（越界取末元素、空侧 inf/−inf），粒度四选（block 全矩阵拼接全局一对/layer/output1 逐行/input1 逐列）后 mask[growth]=False 先、mask[prune]=True 后交换重建；retain_reconstruction 决定 combined 是被剪位回填稠密值还是整体取稠密权重（只在存活位 ref≠weights 时分化）。grad² Fisher 采集显式入参，官方 N:M 结构化分支不在判题域。 773 sparsity-svdllm-whitened-truncation：SVD-LLM 白化域截断压缩——先白化再 SVD 让「截断小奇异值 ⇔ 低压缩损失」直接挂钩：W_scale=W@L 后 svd，参数预算 k=int(M·N·ratio/(M+N))（ratio≤1 时 k 恒 < min(M,N)，只查下界），svd_u=U[:,:k]@√Σ、svd_v=√Σ@(Vᵀ[:k,:]@L⁻¹)（v 侧右乘 L⁻¹ 把白化抵消回去，truncation-aware 核心；L 非满秩防御 +1e-6·I），svd_u@(svd_v@L) 恰为 W@L 的 k 秩最优逼近（Eckart–Young）；direct_update 跳过白化；闭式更新 x'=(x@V_kᵀL⁻¹ᵀ)@Σ_k、updated_uᵀ=lstsq(x',y)（补偿截断损失，updated_error ≤ error），fasterprune 因子 append_u=updated_uᵀᵀ@√Σ、append_v=√Σ@V_kL⁻¹，相对误差 ‖y−xŴᵀ‖_F/‖y‖_F。与 771 划界：白化域谱+L⁻¹ 补偿 vs W 自身谱；与 520 划界：整体降秩 vs 逐列 OB 剪枝。 774 sparsity-zssvd-zero-sum-selection：Zero-Sum SVD 全局奇异分量选择——跨模块统筹低秩预算的秩分配：svd(W@L) 白化域谱 + 梯度白化 H=G@L⁻ᵀ（triangular solve）后取一阶敏感度 grad_σ=diag(UᵀHV)，δ=−σ·grad_σ（second_order 加半平方项、β-mixing 为 −sign(g)·|σ|^β·|g|^(1−β)），亏盈平衡秩 r*=max(1,(mn−1)//(m+n)) 设 min_rank=ceil(keep_ratio·r*) 下限（平衡点之上低秩因子不省参数），选择器维护 running_sum 每轮偏好与累计和反号的符号堆、堆空落到另一堆（pop_prefer_then_any）、|δ| 最小优先按名 tie-break，effective_dense_delta 三段记账（r>r* 记 0、==r* 记 mn−r*(m+n)、<r* 记 m+n）直至 stage_budget 耗尽——零和假设自动产出异质秩。与 773 划界：跨模块预算分配 vs 逐模块固定 k。
description_en: Pruning and sparse storage in model compression: global and per-row magnitude pruning, 2:4 and N:M semi-structured pruning, block-structured and attention-head pruning, scoring with error compensation as in Wanda / OWL / TRIM / SparseGPT, gradual sparsity schedules and dynamic-sparsity drop-grow with STE fine-tuning, plus CSR / ELL / BSR encodings, metadata packing and storage byte ledgers. 770 sparsity-slicegpt-rotate-slice: SliceGPT orthogonal rotate-and-slice — no zeroing, no quantization; the eigenvectors of the calibration H=Σxᵀx (mask==0 tokens zeroed first, diagonal damp=0.01·mean(diag) against degeneracy) form an orthogonal rotation (eigh ascending, columns reordered by descending eigenvalue), then the trailing low-energy dimensions are sliced away for a global rank reduction: W_qkv right-multiplied by Q_in with columns sliced, W_o/W_2 left-multiplied by Q.T with rows sliced (bias rotated and sliced likewise), W_1 right-multiplied by Q_mid with columns sliced (MLP input dim ≡ attn output dim); two shortcut chains attn_shortcut=Q_in.T[:ain]@Q_mid[:,:aout] and mlp_shortcut=(Q_mid.T[:aout]@Q_out)[:,:mout] (float32 matmul) chain the separated blocks back together; damping is diagonal-only (observable via the returned eigenvalues), and mask zeroing clones first for purity. A non-degenerate test spectrum (adjacent eigenvalue gaps > 1e-3) is a precondition, with eigh as a shared primitive and the H construction plus bookkeeping pipeline independently recomputed. 771 sparsity-losparse-decompose: the LoSparse low-rank plus structured-sparse decomposition — W ≈ L@R + S: after svd(full_matrices=False), parameter_ratio takes priority with k=ceil(pr·H·W/(H+W)) (the parameter budget, overriding rank_ratio=ceil(rank·ratio)); the √diag(S) split makes L=U@√diag[:,cols], R=√diag[rows,:]@Vh parameter-balanced with L@R exactly the chosen (max takes the head k / min the tail k) singular-triplet reconstruction; the residual S=W−LR is row-zeroed by neuron_mask (simulating training), surviving neurons extracted by nonzero row sums, and the forward adds x@R.T@L.T plus the full residual term (unpruned) or scatter(x@sparse_pruned.T, nonzero_idx) (pruned) plus bias; a positive ratio through ceil is always ≥1 so only the k upper bound is checked, and count_nonzero(S) sees exact 0 singular values only for exactly zero rows. Boundary with GEAR (residual magnitude top-k elements): LoSparse is row-structured pruning. 772 sparsity-llmbarber-mask-rebuild: the LLM-Barber sparse mask rebuild — an exchange on the existing sparse pattern instead of going back to dense and re-pruning: importance via three metrics (WD=|W|·√scaler, W, D), find_threshold pairs the pruned (growth, descending) and alive (prune, ascending) sets' first min_len entries position-wise, counts strict > differences into recons_num, and takes dual thresholds at idx=int(recons_num·threshold) (last element on overflow, inf/−inf for empty sides); after choosing the scope among four granularities (block: concatenated global pair / layer / output1 per-row / input1 per-column), the mask is exchanged with mask[growth]=False first and mask[prune]=True second, then rebuilt; retain_reconstruction decides whether combined refills pruned positions with dense values or takes the dense weight wholesale (diverges only when alive ref≠weights). The grad² Fisher collection is an explicit input, and the official N:M structured branch is outside the judging scope. 773 sparsity-svdllm-whitened-truncation: the SVD-LLM whitened-domain truncation compression — whiten first, then SVD, so that 'truncate small singular values ⇔ low compression loss' holds directly: svd of W_scale=W@L, parameter budget k=int(M·N·ratio/(M+N)) (with ratio≤1, k is always < min(M,N) so only the lower bound is checked), svd_u=U[:,:k]@√Σ and svd_v=√Σ@(Vᵀ[:k,:]@L⁻¹) (the v side right-multiplies L⁻¹ to undo the whitening — the truncation-aware core; the singular-L defense adds +1e-6·I), and svd_u@(svd_v@L) is exactly the rank-k optimal approximation of W@L (Eckart–Young); direct_update skips whitening; the closed-form update takes x'=(x@V_kᵀL⁻¹ᵀ)@Σ_k and updated_uᵀ=lstsq(x',y) (compensating truncation loss, updated_error ≤ error), with fasterprune factors append_u=updated_uᵀᵀ@√Σ and append_v=√Σ@V_kL⁻¹, and relative error ‖y−xŴᵀ‖_F/‖y‖_F. Boundary with 771: whitened-domain spectrum with L⁻¹ compensation vs W's own spectrum; with 520: global rank reduction vs column-wise OB pruning. 774 sparsity-zssvd-zero-sum-selection: the Zero-Sum SVD global singular-component selection — cross-module rank allocation under a shared low-rank budget: svd of W@L for the whitened spectrum plus gradient whitening H=G@L⁻ᵀ (triangular solve), first-order sensitivity grad_σ=diag(UᵀHV), δ=−σ·grad_σ (second_order adds a half-square term; β-mixing is −sign(g)·|σ|^β·|g|^(1−β)); the break-even rank r*=max(1,(mn−1)//(m+n)) sets the min_rank=ceil(keep_ratio·r*) floor (above break-even the low-rank factors save nothing); the selector keeps a running_sum, each round preferring the sign heap opposite the accumulated sum, falling through to the other heap when empty (pop_prefer_then_any), smallest |δ| first with a name tie-break; effective_dense_delta books savings in three branches (r>r*: 0, r==r*: mn−r*(m+n), r<r*: m+n) until stage_budget is exhausted — the zero-sum assumption yields heterogeneous ranks automatically. Boundary with 773: cross-module budget allocation vs per-module fixed k.

name: 多模态合集
description: 视觉-语言模型的几何重排与对齐训练：ViT patchify 与 Swin 窗口划分，Qwen2-VL 的 smart resize、2×2 patch merge 与 M-RoPE 位置编号，CLIP InfoNCE 与 SigLIP 对比损失，位置嵌入重采样、视频时空 patch 顺序、图像占位展开与混合 batch 整理、Perceiver latent 压缩、Flamingo 门控融合、SAM 提示嵌入与掩码选择、FastV / LLaVA-PruMerge 视觉 token 剪枝与合并（含 IQR 自适应保留数）、Qwen2.5-VL 窗口注意力的重排索引与 cu 窗口边界账、完整 M-RoPE 索引（视频时间轴与交错分段），、FLUX 二维 RoPE 与 single-stream 拼流装配（vec 加法、文本流在前、3 参数调制）。
description_en: Geometric rearrangement and contrastive training in vision-language models: ViT patchify and Swin window partition, Qwen2-VL smart resize / 2x2 patch merge / M-RoPE position ids, CLIP InfoNCE and SigLIP losses, positional-embedding resampling, video spatio-temporal patch order, image placeholder expansion and mixed batch collation, Perceiver latent compression, Flamingo gated fusion, SAM prompt embeddings and mask selection, FastV / LLaVA-PruMerge visual-token pruning and merging (including the IQR-adaptive kept count), Qwen2.5-VL windowed-attention reorder index and cu-window boundary ledger, the full M-RoPE index (video temporal axis and interleaved segmentation), , FLUX 2D RoPE and the single-stream assembly (additive vec, text-first concat, 3-parameter modulation).

name: 语音前端合集
description: 语音模型前端的确定性信号处理：预加重与分帧加窗、STFT 幅度谱（n_fft / hop / center 与反射填充）、Mel 滤波器组与 log-mel（HTK / Slaney 刻度）、MFCC（正交 DCT-II + lifter + CMVN），以及整数比多相重采样。
description_en: Deterministic speech front-ends: pre-emphasis with framing and windowing, STFT magnitude spectra (n_fft / hop / center with reflective padding), Mel filter banks and log-mel (HTK vs Slaney scales), MFCC (orthogonal DCT-II plus liftering and CMVN), and integer-ratio polyphase resampling.

name: 向量检索合集
description: 向量检索与 RAG 检索管线：IVF 粗量化分配与 nprobe 多探测归并、乘积量化编码与 ADC 打分、k-means Lloyd 迭代，HNSW 建图插入与贪心搜索，BM25、倒排 postings 与 Block-Max WAND、ColBERT MaxSim，RRF 融合与 MMR 重排，以及重叠滑窗、late chunking 与父子块扩展的分块策略。
description_en: Vector retrieval and the RAG pipeline: IVF coarse assignment with nprobe multi-probe merging, product quantization encoding and ADC scoring, k-means Lloyd iterations, HNSW insertion and greedy search, BM25, inverted postings with Block-Max WAND and ColBERT MaxSim, RRF fusion and MMR re-ranking, plus chunking strategies such as overlapping sliding windows, late chunking and parent-child block expansion.

name: LLM 评测指标合集
description: LLM 评测与数据卫生的确定性指标：困惑度与忽略位的 token 准确率、语料级 BLEU、ROUGE-1/2/L 与最长公共子序列、pass@k 无偏估计、nDCG@k 折损累积增益、few-shot 提示预算截断，shingle 污染审计，以及 LLM-as-judge pairwise 的 swap 两局位置偏差账与半胜聚合。 IF-Eval 结构判别器三类账：JSON 整体包裹的多级反引号剥除与标量/扩展解析口径、postscript 落款的三分支正则与 marker 不转义通配 quirk、双答案 6 星分隔的空段位置账。 另有裁判输出里数值分数串的解析层：`[[a, b]]` / `[[r]]` 四条正则的主备份两级、`\s?` 恰一 Unicode 空白、`\d+\.?\d*` 不带符号与前导零字面量，成对模式的 tie_delta 浮点边界，以及单点模式 `-1` 哨兵下的 (model, turn) 均值表。
description_en: Deterministic metrics for LLM evaluation and data hygiene: perplexity and token accuracy with ignored positions, corpus-level BLEU, ROUGE-1/2/L with LCS, the unbiased pass@k estimator, nDCG@k discounted cumulative gain, few-shot prompt budget truncation, and shingle-based contamination audits. plus the LLM-as-judge pairwise swap-two-game position-bias ledger with half-win aggregation. The IF-Eval structure-checker trio: whole-output JSON wrapping with multi-level backtick stripping and scalar/extension parsing rules, the postscript three-branch regex with the un-escaped-marker wildcard quirk, and the six-asterisk dual-response empty-segment position ledger. Also the numeric score-string parsing layer of judge outputs: the four-regex primary/backup tiers for `[[a, b]]` / `[[r]]`, the exactly-one Unicode whitespace of `\s?`, the unsigned `\d+\.?\d*` with its leading-zero literal rule, the tie_delta float boundary in pairwise mode, and the (model, turn) mean table under the single-mode `-1` sentinel.

name: RL 基建合集
description: 大模型强化学习训练栈的系统与数据流账：优先经验回放的采样与 IS 权重、rollout 跨 rank 重分片与 padding-free 打包、actor/critic/ref 多模型 colocate 的显存与阶段时间线、奖励归一化的批统计管道、异步 rollout 的准入与陈旧度，以及多段 episode 拼装与截断 bootstrap。 784 rl-vineppo-mc-value：VinePPO 步级 Monte-Carlo 回报账（叶判定 "answer" in node、pred 从 answer 提取而节点自带 pred 字段不参与、内部均值与树形差分 advantage；路径抽取的 importance_weight=bf^(max_depth−depth) 与浅叶重复、逐节点 pop("children")；聚合 chosen、reward 严格 < max 才出对，下标 = repeat*num_tasks+task）。
description_en: Systems and data-flow accounting in the RL training stack for LLMs: prioritized experience replay sampling with importance-sampling weights, cross-rank rollout resharding and padding-free packing, the memory and phase timeline when colocating actor/critic/reference models, batch statistics for reward normalization, admission and staleness in asynchronous rollouts, and multi-segment episode assembly with truncated bootstrapping. 784 rl-vineppo-mc-value: VinePPO's step-level Monte-Carlo return accounting (leaf detection via "answer" in node, pred extracted from the answer while the node's own pred field plays no part, internal means and tree-differenced advantages; path extraction with importance_weight = bf^(max_depth-depth) and shallow-leaf repetition plus per-node pop("children"); aggregation with unique's sort_keys set dedup, top_k_percent counting the root's advantage as 0 in the mean denominator, max_k_paths' fixed-seed sampling; filtering where successful reads the last node's is_correct_answer while non_zero_score reads the first step; the char -777 / token -999 dual-sentinel apportionment and multi-char tokens taking their start char). 786 rl-arpo-entropy-branch: ARPO's entropy-aware rollout branching ledger (top-10 truncated entropy -Σp·l normalized by log(vocab), the 20-token window with missing fallback, initial_entropy_dict frozen on first sight; entropy-delta-gated branching with prob=clamp(rand−w×delta) under a strict > gate and the remaining_slots / beam_size−1 / created triple-cap interlock; one init_inputs cold-restart refill per round for inactive samples; EOS append on tool-quota exhaustion and the reorg's duplicate-to-fill). 787 rl-ktae-token-advantage: KTAE's token-level advantage ledger (correct/wrong pools split by reward sign, a per-token 2x2 contingency table over distinct row counts; Fisher exact via a lgamma numeric approximation with exp(-2p) and p==1 squashed to 0, log2 information gain, BM25-saturated frequencies k1=2 b=0.5, arcsine-Cohen distance; signal fusion (α·fisher+β·ig)·x/(α+β) rescaled by (sigmoid-0.5)·2·top, the hardcoded 151643 zeroing and a table sized max_token_num+1; the group-standardized outcome tile×eos_mask plus token-id-indexed weights, and the native single-row-group zero table sized responses.max() without the +1). 788 rl-greso-prefilter: GRESO's pre-rollout selective filtering ledger (the DataProfiler's six skips: easy_example's exact reward==1 with an epoch window, the easy/hard linear-backoff and probabilistic skips' trailing-run semantics — easy breaks below 0.98, hard breaks above 0.11 behind the latest-reward solvable gate, backoff anchored at the whole-trace max epoch, skip_prob=1−max(p^count,0.01) with lazy rand draws; the batch filter's three-state skip_log; zero-variance groups dropped whole ahead of the int(reminder/(1−zvr)/n·1.25) adaptive refill and the [64,default] clamp; p_easy/p_hard adapting by ±0.01 against the measured ratios against target/3 and target·2/3). 789 rl-tournament-grpo: the Tournament-GRPO elimination-reward ledger (stack-based transcript parsing with close-tag fallback to the nearest matching open tag, silently dropped unclosed middles, and error sets in TAG_ERRORS' fixed order; the strict <answer> four-gate plus the 0/1 format gate over structural checks — a think opening, a google_search loop per think block, browse loops, and the call_tool→tool_output→think cycle; the G=2 bracket over M=4 repeats sharing one rng with round-robin grouping candidates[i::num_groups] yielding odd 3-way groups and +1 per win; min-max normalization mapping all-equal scores to 0.5 and zeroing no-answer candidates after normalization; total = normalized tournament score + format score in [0,2]). 790 rl-opsd-turn-credit: the AgentOPSD turn-level credit ledger (in-group GRPO sequence advantages with the unclipped group mean as the initial belief; token-level teacher−student logprob gaps summed along turn boundaries into evidence, the prefix-length difference shifting every action range, zip-truncation semantics; the Bayesian-inspired belief recursion c_k=γ·c_{k-1}+e_k (c_0=0), B_k=σ(logit(b0)+c_k), b0=clip(group mean, ε, 1−ε); outcome_credit=sign(A_seq)·(B_k−B_{k-1}) — the marginal change, not the isolated gap; standardized then weight=clip(1+b·z,1−b,1+b) and A_turn=A_seq·((1−λ)+λ·w), redistributing magnitude without flipping direction; degenerate groups with all-zero advantages excluded from training; PPO arrays broadcasting into action ranges with right-shift alignment). 791 rl-malt-tree-attribution: the MALT search-tree credit attribution ledger (a G→V→R three-level tree of n³ trajectories, two layers of sibling-expectation backprop V(v)=(1/n)Σ_l V(r) and V(g)=(1/n)Σ_k V(v) with no discount factor; the strict >0.5 threshold binarization aligned with majority voting where exactly 0.5 is judged incorrect; DPO preference pairs grouped by shared parent context — D_R under the same verifier output, D_V under the same generator output, D_G under the same question with the Generator SFT-only — as the full positive×negative subset combination within each parent; SFT positives take the leaf reward on the R layer and the binarized ✓ on V/G; no official code exists, so the semantics are the paper formula's unique deterministic arithmetic). 792 rl-sweet-rl-turn-critic: the SWEET-RL turn-level critic ledger (the critic prompt injects the training-time ground-truth prefix — 'In light that the final answer is: ...' at three injection sites; the judge score's four-step extraction: [:-4] dropping the empty-response tail, skipping None with synchronized collection, taking the logprobs after the LAST eos, then sum or mean (use_sum = the length-normalization switch); judge scores minus the same-shaped reference baseline before a descending rerank; preference-pair generation — an ascending argsort taken by position with chosen drawn from the lower half and rejected from the upper half, then swapped by actual score so chosen is higher, no_prompt concatenating input into the response side, the get_sft official chosen==rejected quirk, and the random.seed(42) global seed replaying pair-by-pair; gt_pairs — the argmax repeat per task is chosen and only rewards strictly < max produce pairs, index = repeat*num_tasks+task).

ADaPT as-needed decomposition ledger: the try-first-decompose-on-failure recursion — every string task runs the executor once (`range(1, max_runs)` stops one short, patience uses `==` and its triggering step never reaches the completion, a drained loop wipes the reward too, think actions skip history but still burn turns), returns on success or at the depth cap (so `max_depth=1` never decomposes and a failed capped attempt still appends its text); otherwise it plans (+1 run) and parses: `Step` prefixes stripped, the execution-order line matched as a substring and split on the last `": "`, the last logic word at a level winning, parentheses nesting, and any parse error falling back wholesale to flat + AND; a parenthesised group is an already-parsed plan that runs no executor, calls no planner and adds no depth; AND returns on the first failure and OR on the first success, completion only accumulates successful children, and the checkpoint only takes real actions of successful leaves; `info_prop` demands the literal `Task completed!` (inconsistent with the executor's lowercase test), drops two lines before skipping think pairs and slips when the text ends with a real action, while all-step mode is effectively always empty because the child-success branch only handles last-step. Chain of Agents sequential relay ledger: long text is relayed instead of crammed — paragraph-first chunking that skips whitespace-only paragraphs, normalizes in-paragraph whitespace, hard-cuts over-long paragraphs into full-window chunks, keeps the tail as the next chunk's start, lets a block that just reached `k` words linger until the next paragraph, never emits an empty chunk, and reports each chunk's word span in the source plus `CU_0` as the empty string, workers that see only the **previous** CU (never the full history), a chunk with no relevant information keeping the previous CU instead of blanking it, and truncation by words only when `max_cu` is exceeded (truncation normalizes whitespace via tokenization while the untruncated path returns text verbatim); the manager consumes only the last CU — footnote 1 states that feeding it all CUs hurts, and the public `rudrankriyam/Chain-of-Agents` implementation does exactly that, so this problem follows the paper and makes the distinction part of the ledger; `left-to-right` changes only the processing order while the chunk table keeps source numbering (so reversing makes `cu_l` the CU of the first source chunk); the two caps are split into `k` (chunking window) and `window` (optional agent-window check, off by default), and `answer` is returned verbatim without stripping. Zep bi-temporal edge invalidation ledger: every fact edge carries event time (`valid_at`/`invalid_at`) alongside transaction time (`expired_at`); when a new fact supersedes an old one, the former records the moment it stopped being true while the latter records this ingest's `now`. Timestamps are extracted for new edges only, and any pre-existing timestamp skips the whole extraction. <digits><at most one whitespace>. ` (word count, twelve ` ` keywords, the `Write a program` prefix applied after `capitalize()`, leading punctuation / non-ASCII), plus threshold dedup over a pool that grows with each accepted instruction, the top-k most-similar ledger and prompt numbering. Also the FunSearch island programs database: clustering by the per-test score vector with the cluster score frozen at its first member, a cluster softmax whose temperature decays linearly with the island program count, length-weighted in-cluster sampling, and weak-island reset with founder cloning ordered by `(island best, island id)`. Also Darwin Godel Machine archive evolution: a candidate table whose `children_count` only counts in-archive parent links, sigmoid-of-score parent probabilities (`best` is copied from the official ascending sort, i.e. it picks the worst), short-circuiting dispatch through three 25% gates, a three-stage compile filter (metadata / empty patch / test count), an admission gate at initial-minus-leeway, and a full-eval threshold that counts `initial` twice. Also the ACE skillbook: `ADD/UPDATE/TAG/REMOVE` delta semantics (the `_UNSET` sentinel, empty list meaning "leave alone", empty string meaning "clear"), keyword normalization with legacy section folding, sign-only `delta` counters for helpful/harmful/neutral, soft delete versus purge, and fixed-order prompt rendering. Also the Voyager skill library: a same-name add overwrites instead of appending (entry count and dict position unchanged), dump names probe from `V2` for the first free slot, the `async function <name>(bot) { // ... }` description template, `min(library size, retrieval_top_k)` similarity retrieval with ties by insertion order, and `programs` concatenating skills before primitives. Also the ExpeL insight ledger: rule operations parsed as `(REMOVE|EDIT|ADD|AGREE)( number)?: [label: ]body` and passed through three gates (non-empty / free of three banned words / ending with a period), a repair pass that dedupes ADD and downgrades EDIT to AGREE, the fixed `REMOVE->AGREE->EDIT->ADD` application order with its counter semantics (ADD=2, AGREE=+1, REMOVE=-1 or -3 when full, EDIT=+1), plus eviction at zero and a stable descending sort. Also the TravelPlanner constraint sandbox: a closed-circle / singleton-run / state-of-middle-node check over city nodes that `from A to B` doubles (three days give five nodes), whole-string meal de-duplication across days, the `split(';')[:-1]` attraction string that drops its tail, `minimum_nights` compared against run lengths (skipped when several rows match), the `taxi->self-driving->flight` conflict table, sandbox lookups by "name substring plus exact city" with the name split at the last comma, and a 50% fill-rate account whose numerator counts `current_city` too.

name: 视觉检测合集
description: 检测与分割流水线的基础算子与账本：anchor 生成与 IoU 阈值匹配、FCOS center-ness 与多尺度层分配、WBF 加权框融合、mAP 的 11-point / all-point / COCO 三种口径、COCO RLE 编解码与 mask IoU、FPN 融合与层尺寸账，以及旋转框 NMS 与可变形采样偏移聚合、YOLOv1 无 anchor 网格责任编码（截断重算 + sqrt 编码 + 先到先得仲裁）与平移/平方互逆 decode、YOLOv3 anchor 系 best-anchor 匹配与 xy 线性偏移 / wh log-exp 互逆的编解码账、SPP-Net 金字塔池化的 caffe kernel/pad 划分账（重叠窗口与空 bin quirk）、YOLOv4 Mosaic 四象限拼接的 truth 平移/收缩修正/终门与 copy_plan 账、KL-Loss variance voting 的槽位序贪心 + 逐坐标方差加权融合账（+1 约定 IoU、thresh 钳制、任何正重叠衰减、tail-swap 移除）、YOLOX SimOTA 的几何粗筛（1.5·stride 邻域）+ cost 三项 + dynamic-k（int 截断）与冲突仲裁账、YOLOv5 build_targets 的 wh 双向比粗筛（格宽/像素 anchor 混搭）+ 五方向 0.5 偏移双门扩展 + 截断格点账、YOLOv8 TAL 的对齐分（类分^α·CIoU^β）top-k + overlap 仲裁 + 软标签归一（eps 淹没效应）账。 R-FCN 位置敏感 RoI 池化：k² 通道按 (i,j) bin 各取一路、bin 内均值、k² 个 bin 等权投票（空 bin 记 0 仍进分母）。 DFL 分布式框回归：reg_max+1 个 bin 的 softmax 期望解码，以及左右两个相邻 bin 的交叉熵按 wl/wr 加权（目标必须落在 [0, reg_max-1]）。
description_en: Foundational operators and ledgers in detection and segmentation pipelines: anchor generation with IoU-threshold matching, FCOS center-ness and multi-scale level assignment, weighted box fusion, mAP under the 11-point, all-point and COCO conventions, COCO RLE encoding/decoding and mask IoU, FPN top-down fusion with layer size accounting, plus rotated-box NMS and deformable sampling-offset aggregation, YOLOv1 anchor-free grid-responsibility encoding (post-clamp recomputation, sqrt encoding, first-come-first-served arbitration) with its translate/square inverse decode, and YOLOv3 best-anchor matching with the linear-offset-xy / log-exp-wh encode-decode ledger, and the SPP-Net pyramid pooling caffe kernel/pad windowing ledger (overlapping windows and the empty-bin quirk), and the YOLOv4 Mosaic quadrant-blend truth ledger (quadrant shifts, shrink corrections, final gate, copy_plan), and the KL-Loss variance-voting ledger (slot-order greedy + per-coordinate sigma-weighted fusion, +1-convention IoU, thresh clamp, any-positive-overlap decay, tail-swap removal), and the YOLOX SimOTA ledger (1.5·stride neighborhood pre-filter, triple cost, int-truncated dynamic-k, conflict arbitration), and the YOLOv5 build_targets ledger (two-sided wh-ratio pre-filter with the grid/pixel mixup, five-direction dual-gate 0.5-offset expansion, truncated grid cells), and the YOLOv8 TAL ledger (align = score^alpha * CIoU^beta top-k, overlap arbitration, soft-label normalization with the eps-swallowing effect). R-FCN position-sensitive RoI pooling: each of the k² channels serves one (i,j) bin, bins are averaged internally, and the k² bins vote equally with empty bins still counted as zeros. DFL distributional box regression: expectation decoding over reg_max+1 softmax bins, and the weighted pair of cross-entropies at the two neighbouring bins (targets confined to [0, reg_max-1]).

name: 自动微分反向合集
description: 反向传播的逐算子账本：softmax 与交叉熵（label smoothing / ignore_index）、linear/matmul 的 dX 与 dW，LayerNorm / RMSNorm / BatchNorm 训练态，注意力与 FlashAttention 反向、GQA 折头求和，Embedding 重复 id 累加，conv2d 与池化的路由分摊，LSTM 沿时间累加与截断 BPTT，激活与 Dropout、weight_norm 重参数化的逐元素反向，以及用中心差分校验自定义 autograd.Function。
description_en: Per-operator backward ledgers: softmax and cross-entropy (label smoothing / ignore_index) and dX/dW for linear/matmul, LayerNorm / RMSNorm / training-mode BatchNorm, attention and FlashAttention backward with GQA head folding, Embedding duplicate-id accumulation, conv2d and pooling routing, LSTM accumulation over time with truncated BPTT, elementwise backward for activations, dropout and weight_norm re-parameterization, and custom autograd.Function checks against central differences.

name: 数值稳定合集
description: 浮点与归约的数值稳定性：补偿求和与成对求和、Welford 在线均值方差、跳 NaN 归约的计数与哨兵语义、bfloat16 舍入与 FP8 分块缩放、随机舍入的无偏与偏置方向、分块 online softmax 只交换 (max, sum) 的重标定合并，以及先按段缩放再归约的安全 p 范数。
description_en: Numerical stability of floating point and reductions: compensated and pairwise summation, Welford's online mean and variance, count and sentinel semantics for NaN-skipping reductions, bfloat16 rounding and FP8 block scaling, unbiased versus biased stochastic rounding, sharded online softmax that merges by exchanging only (max, sum), and the safe p-norm that scales each segment before reducing.

name: 上下文压缩合集
description: 推理时压缩的两条战线。Prompt 侧三个路数：按词级重要性剪词（LLMLingua-2 用小型分类器判「该删哪个词」）、按文档预算分配（LongLLMLingua 按困惑度给每篇文档算 token 预算、两阶段窗口细裁）、查询注意力过滤（QUITO 以子词 max 聚合、高斯平滑与词/句两级贪心预算钉死打分后的规则链）、训练编码器句级整句取舍（CPC 用 boost 正则优先与 add-then-break 的 token 预算贪心）、以及预填期一次性裁输入（GemFilter 用早层注意力给输入 token 打分取 top-k）；权重侧以 Basis Sharing 为代表——跨层拼接联合 SVD，组内共享基向量、每层只留窄系数，白化预处理与最小二乘系数重解全程确定性；D2-MoE 则把专家权重拆成 Fisher 加权共享 base 与低秩 delta，白化 SVD 与共享 V 因子全程零训练。所有题都复现上游的精确打分、选择与分解规则，任何一步换一种「想当然」的实现都会得到另一份结果。
description_en: Two fronts of inference-time compression. On the prompt side, three routes: word-level importance pruning (LLMLingua-2 uses a small classifier to decide which words to drop), per-document budget allocation (LongLLMLingua assigns token budgets by perplexity and refines with two-stage windows), query-attention filtering (QUITO pins the entire post-scoring rule chain: subword max aggregation, Gaussian smoothing, and two-level greedy budgets), trained-encoder whole-sentence selection (CPC with regex-boost priority and an add-then-break token-budget greedy), and one-shot input pruning at prefill (GemFilter scores input tokens with early-layer attention and takes the top-k). On the weight side, Basis Sharing concatenates layers for a joint SVD — the group shares one basis while each layer keeps narrow coefficients, with deterministic whitening and least-squares coefficient re-solves; D2-MoE splits expert weights into a Fisher-weighted shared base and low-rank deltas, all zero-training. Every problem reproduces the upstream scoring, selection and factorization rules exactly; any "obvious" shortcut yields a different answer.

name: 线性注意力与状态空间合集
description: 次二次复杂度序列建模的核心递推账：Mamba 的 selective scan 参考实现（deltaA 指数衰减、deltaB_u 输入注入、D 跳连与 z 门、变体 einsum 与数值精度口径）、Gated DeltaNet 的门控线性递推（状态指数遗忘、误差校正写入 (v−h·k)β、按头 scale 与输出读出）、RWKV v6 的 per-token 逐通道衰减 WKV 递推（(a,b,p) log-space 三元组、bonus 只进输出分支、w 加在旧指数上），以及 Gated Linear Attention 的 chunk 并行恒等式（段内含入 cumsum、段间/段内两支拆分、段末衰减按 key 通道逐行），以及 xLSTM mLSTM 的三形式纯数值账（recurrent step 的 m_state log-sum-exp 稳定化与 fg/ig 双门激活、h_denom 由 exp(-m_new) 定下界；parallel 形式由 cumsum 差分 + [1:,1:] 偏移构造 log_fg_matrix 与 D 矩阵、stabilize_rowwise 两路、normalizer 由 exp(-max_log_D) 定下界；chunkwise 的 chunk 内 loggates / m_loc / kv / ksum）。
description_en: Core recurrence ledgers of sub-quadratic sequence modeling: Mamba's selective-scan reference implementation (deltaA exponential decay, deltaB_u input injection, the D skip connection and z gate, variant einsums and numerical-precision conventions), the gated linear recurrence of Gated DeltaNet (exponential state forgetting, the error-correcting write (v−h·k)β, per-head scale and the output read), RWKV v6's per-token per-channel-decay WKV recurrence ((a,b,p) log-space triplet, bonus only in the output branch, w applied to the old exponent), and Gated Linear Attention's chunked-parallel identity (inclusive in-chunk cumsum, inter/intra split, end-of-chunk decay applied row-wise per key channel), and the three pure numeric ledgers of xLSTM mLSTM (the m_state log-sum-exp stabilizer and fg/ig dual gates of the recurrent step, with h_denom lower-bounded by exp(-m_new); the parallel form's log_fg_matrix and D matrix built from cumsum differences plus a [1:,1:] offset, both stabilize_rowwise paths, and a normalizer lower-bounded by exp(-max_log_D); and chunkwise intra-chunk loggates / m_loc / kv / ksum).

name: 可解释性合集
description: 打开模型内部的两把扳手加一读一写：稀疏自编码器的 TopK 重构账（减 b_dec 后编码、top-k 不做 ReLU、解码重构与 l0 / mse / max_feat 三项指标）、tuned lens 的逐层仿射探针（W_l h_l + b_l 直读 final logits、按层 CE 与 KL(p_final‖p_layer)、float64 稳定计算）、logit lens 的免训练读出账（中间隐态过 final LayerNorm + unembed、argmax 并列取小、agree 与 rank_of_final 排名账），以及 activation steering 的注入账（同层累加、normalize 语义、cos_before/after 与 proj_coef 正交化账）。
description_en: Two wrenches plus a read and a write for opening up a model: the TopK sparse-autoencoder reconstruction ledger (encode after subtracting b_dec, top-k without ReLU, decoded reconstruction with l0 / mse / max_feat metrics), tuned-lens per-layer affine probes (W_l h_l + b_l reading straight into final logits, per-layer CE and KL(p_final‖p_layer), float64-stable computation), the training-free logit-lens readout ledger (intermediate states through the final LayerNorm + unembed, argmax ties to smallest index, agree and rank_of_final accounting), and the activation-steering injection ledger (same-layer accumulation, normalize semantics, cos_before/after and the proj_coef orthogonalization account).

name: 推理系统合集
description: 推理期把 N 份候选折成一个答案、再把预算折成行为的确定性账本：self-consistency 的答案归一化与加权计票（8 条钉死的归一化规则、首次出现序票仓、并列取先者）、PRM best-of-N 的步级聚合（last / max / min / product 四种口径、answer_scores 乘项、并列取小 index 的 top-m 排序）、s1 budget forcing 的三段状态机（步级截断触发 length forcing、Wait 续跑扣预算、回答按剩余截断），以及 overthinking 指标账（答对/答错平均 token 数与效率比、准确率-长度分箱、best_bin 并列取小）。 TTRL 多数票伪奖励账：把「用自采样造标签再反算奖励」这条测试时流水线摊成账——从原始输出里用**最后一次** `\boxed` 配平抽答案（`}` 先于 `{` 或前缀不是 `\boxed{` 都抽不到，`\boxed{}` 得到合法空串，`\fbox` 不算）、丢掉抽不出的再逐个过化简表（每个值只查一次、链式表不连锁）、按首次出现序计票且**平票取先者**、比例分母是样本数 `n` 而非成功抽出条数；一条都没抽出来时兜底成**字符串** `"None"` 与 `0.0`（因此真值写成 `"None"` 会给满分）；伪标签奖励与真值奖励分两路（真值含 `\boxed` 先抽再化简、抽坏了这题真值奖励全 0），五项指标（`label_accuracy`、逐样本相等的 `reward_accuracy`、两个奖励均值、`sum >= 1` 的 `pass@n`）跨题平均且**键序取第一题**、`majority_ratio` 追加在末尾；降采样每块只留前 `keep` 条却不检查 `keep <= n`（越界抛 `IndexError`），且选完把 `keep` 当成新的 `n` 重跑整条流水线。 Stream of Search 轨迹序列化账：把「搜索过程即语言」摊成编码 + 解码两半——编码侧一个纯启发式驱动的 DFS 逐行写状态、操作与前进/回溯标记（一次合并固定四序：加、乘、**大减小**、**大除小且只在整除时**，剩余数字保原序而新结果追加末尾；子节点先按 `<= threshold` 过滤、再按启发式**稳定**升序、最后编号 `父编号,本层序号`，剪掉的分支不占编号；只剩一个数时命中就写 `equal: Goal Reached` 并**整棵停下**、不命中写 `unequal` 且**不下探**；兄弟之间的衔接写的是**父节点**状态；官方末尾那段 `if open_set:` 回溯提示是死代码，所以轨迹可以停在 `unequal` 行上没有收尾），解码侧按官方解析器逐步重放（首行 `re.match` 锚定、goal 取**第一个**、达成步取它之前**最后一个** `Exploring Operation`、父状态取**最后一条** `Current State`；判词九选一，非法分支还带具体操作与「池子里有什么」）；两个头号陷阱：空 `Operations` 列表被切出一个空串，2 个数字的实例**一步命中反而拿 0 分**；可用数字池只增不减（`int` 比 `str` 恒真），同一个数字能被反复用而查不出来；评级 = `max(1 - (Exploring 行数 + 1)/满树节点数, 0)`，满树只按初始数字个数查表（2→4、3→48、4→1152、5→46080），所以合法轨迹也可能被夹到 0。 775 cot-auto-cluster-demos：Auto-CoT 聚类选代表拼 demo——聚类分配与到质心距离矩阵显式入参（编码与 KMeans 拟合不入判题域），簇内按距心距离**稳定升序**逐候选过五重过滤（问题 ≤60 词、rationale 行数 ≤max_ra_len、以句点结尾、答案非空、算术答案回验：倒数第二句 `split(".")[-2]` 或尾 10 词须含答案——句点结尾保证 [-2] 不越界），首个通过者 break 独占该簇名额，rationale 清洗 `" ".join(split())` 空白折叠（replace 链在此语义下冗余），簇按编号序拼出异质 demo 集，空簇/全被过滤的簇无 demo；稳定排序即 tie-break（分簇按 sid 升序 append），距离矩阵非所属列是死数据但读错列会改变簇内排序。 776 cot-active-uncertainty-select：Active-Prompt 不确定度选样——每题 k 次采样的抽取后答案串计数（空答案进哨兵键 -10086），数值任务把 occurrence 展开成 float 列表算总体方差（ddof=0，**哨兵 -10086 也原样计入**——全无解的题方差巨大是官方真实行为），熵走 scipy 口径 -Σ(c/n)·ln(c/n)（0 频率贡献 0、全零 nan、判题环境无 scipy 自实现对齐），disagreement 为 distinct 答案数（strategyqa 预置 yes/no 零频键恒算两键）；排序 stable 且平局保持输入序——disagreement -len 降序（strategyqa 特例 abs(yes-no) **升序**，官方 except 兜底是死分支）、variance -variance 降序**仅数值任务**（官方 elif 带 dataset 过滤不匹配静默不排序）、entropy 降序；qes_limit 只算前 N 题且排序作用于子集；python 的 reverse=True 平局保持原序与 -key 恒等。 777 cot-self-verify-backward：Self-Verification 后向验证——k 份采样答案 str(float(x)) 规范化 + 首现去重得候选集；对每个候选把问题文本（逗号先转句点、最后一个句号处截断）findall(r'-?\d+\.?\d*') 抽全部数字逐个替换为 'X' 构造挖空子问题（字符列表切片赋值、官方 number_find 置位缺失故每个含该数字的句段都替换、replace('..','.') 修尾空段双句点、**最多前 3 个数字**；跨句点数字与句点尾数字在句段内匹配不到 → 挖空不发生是官方陷阱），declarative 改写缓存走**最后一次出现的 answers[0]** 反向定位替换（≡rfind）或 fallback 模板（空缓存经 else 分支同落 fallback）；verifier 判定串与挖空原数字**双向独立 try float** 一致者计分（数字版 verifier 非 TF 版），候选总分 argmax **平局取最前**，is_true 对照规范化 GT；判定串池按 a_idx*3+d 扁平索引（不足 3 个子问题的尾部槽是死槽），单候选 scores={0:1} 不验证。 778 cot-rot-recursion-stack：RoT 递归求解序列构造——把一道算术题按 rot 范式编译成一条 seq2seq 训练序列：tokenizer 按 '\\c' 转义与 '<...>' 特殊 token 切分（未闭合整段丢弃、'<> '空特殊 token 合法）；x 从 tokenize(问题) 起、y 为 x 右移一位，逐 thought 注入——x 收子问题与子答案 token，y 收子问题 token + '<THINK>' 再补 len(子答案)-1 个 '<PAD>'，label 记 len(子问题)+1 个 T与 len(子答案)-1 个 PAD，三流长度不变量 len(x)==len(y)==len(label) 由「base 少 1 → 每 thought 补 1 →答案再补 1」维持；tail thought 把首 token 换成 '<TAIL>'（x/y 双侧）、子答案与主答案都不发射（无 Alabel、y 以 '<THINK>' 收尾），tail 后非 tail 非法；Compare 同位数才递归且 int(str[1:]) 前导零丢失（105 余位是 5）、位数不等零 thought；Add 进位链先追加 (l//10,1) 后自增（l_rest=0 时 (0,1) 仍发生，9+91）、l_rest>0 and r_rest>0 才有第三段；Mul 双 base（×0/×1 与九九表）+ 分解支（r=10 走 >=10 支且r%10=0 部分积为 0）+ tail 加法 (a2*10, a1) a2 在高位；ProbGraph 按 (problem,args) 节点 DFS 先序去重展开（重复节点只在首现处展开子树），cot 范式前序展平**不去重**且 tail 只出问题不出答案。 779 cot-cumulative-verified：Cumulative Reasoning 的 Game24 累积态验证账——proposer/valid 判定/verifier 三类 LLM 输出全显式入参（rounds 脚本），每轮从 a=remaining
