description_en: Deterministic ledgers that fold N candidates into one answer and a budget into behavior at inference time: self-consistency answer normalization and weighted voting (8 pinned normalization rules, first-occurrence-order tallies, ties to the earliest), PRM best-of-N step aggregation (the last / max / min / product rules, the answer_scores multiplier, top-m ranking with ties to the smaller index), the s1 budget-forcing three-phase state machine (step truncation triggering length forcing, Wait extensions consuming budget, the answer truncated by the remainder), and the overthinking metric ledger (mean tokens of correct vs wrong answers with the efficiency ratio, accuracy-length binning, best_bin with ties to the smallest). TTRL majority-vote pseudo-reward ledger: the test-time pipeline that mints a label from its own samples and scores against it, laid out as a book — answers are mined from raw completions by balancing braces from the **last** `\boxed` (a `}` before any `{`, or a prefix other than `\boxed{`, extracts nothing; `\boxed{}` yields a legal empty string; `\fbox` does not count), unparsed samples are dropped and the rest go through the simplification table once each (so chained tables do not chain), votes are tallied in first-seen order with **ties to the earliest**, and the ratio divides by the sample count `n` rather than by the number of extractions; when nothing parses at all the fallback is the **string** `"None"` with `0.0` (so a ground truth of `"None"` scores full marks). Pseudo-label and ground-truth rewards are separate paths (a `\boxed` ground truth is extracted then canonicalized, and a mangled one zeroes every ground-truth reward), and five metrics (`label_accuracy`, sample-wise `reward_accuracy`, the two reward means, and `pass@n` from `sum >= 1`) average across questions with the **key order taken from the first question** while `majority_ratio` is appended last. Downsampling keeps only the first `keep` samples per block without checking `keep <= n` (overflow raises `IndexError`) and then reruns the whole pipeline with `keep` as the new `n`. Stream of Search trace serialization ledger: "the search process as language" split into encoding and decoding halves. The encoder is a heuristic-driven DFS that writes one line per state, operation and forward/backward move (one merge always offers add, multiply, **larger minus smaller**, and **larger over smaller only when it divides evenly**; unused numbers keep their order and the new result is appended last; children are filtered by `<= threshold`, sorted **stably** by heuristic and only then numbered `<parent id>,<position>`, so pruned branches take no id; a single number either writes `equal: Goal Reached` and **stops the whole tree** or writes `unequal` and **is not descended**; the hand-off between siblings writes the **parent's** state; and the upstream `if open_set:` backtrack hint is dead code, so a trace may end on an `unequal` line with no closing marker). The decoder replays the trace the way the official parser does (first line anchored with `re.match`, the goal is the **first** match, the goal step is the **last** `Exploring Operation` before it, the parent state is the **last** `Current State`; one of nine verdict strings, invalid ones naming the offending operation and what the pool held). Two leading traps: an empty `Operations` list splits into one empty string, so a two-number instance that hits on the first move **scores 0**; and the available pool only grows (comparing `int` against `str` is always true), so the same number can be reused undetected. The rating is `max(1 - (Exploring lines + 1)/full-tree nodes, 0)` with the full-tree size looked up from the initial number count alone (2→4, 3→48, 4→1152, 5→46080), so even a valid trace can be clamped to 0. 775 cot-auto-cluster-demos: the Auto-CoT cluster-representative demo assembly — the clustering assignment and centroid-distance matrix are explicit inputs (encoding and KMeans fitting are outside the judging scope); each cluster's candidates are walked in **stably ascending** centroid-distance order through five filters (question ≤60 words, rationale lines ≤max_ra_len, ends with a period, non-empty answer, arithmetic answer verification: the penultimate sentence `split(".")[-2]` or the last 10 words must contain the answer — the trailing period guarantees [-2] is in bounds), the first passer breaks and takes the whole cluster slot, rationales are cleaned by `" ".join(split())` whitespace folding (the replace chain is redundant under this semantics), clusters assemble in id order into a heterogeneous demo set, and empty or fully-filtered clusters contribute nothing; the stable sort is the tie-break (clusters append in ascending sid order), and the non-assigned columns of the distance matrix are dead data, though reading the wrong column changes the intra-cluster ordering. 776 cot-active-uncertainty-select: the Active-Prompt uncertainty-based sample selection — per-question k sampled post-extraction answer strings are tallied (empty answers go to the -10086 sentinel key), numerical tasks expand the occurrence into a float list for the population variance (ddof=0, **the -10086 sentinel enters as-is** — a question with no successful samples gets a huge variance, real official behavior), the entropy follows the scipy convention -Σ(c/n)·ln(c/n) (zero frequencies contribute 0, all-zero is nan, no scipy in the judging env so the self-implementation matches), and disagreement is the distinct-answer count (strategyqa's preset yes/no zero-frequency keys always count as two); sorting is stable with ties keeping the input order — disagreement -len descending (strategyqa special-cases abs(yes-no) **ascending**, the official except fallback being a dead branch), variance -variance descending **numerical only** (the official elif filters by dataset and silently skips sorting otherwise), entropy descending; qes_limit computes only the first N questions and sorting applies within the subset; python's reverse=True keeps ties in original order, identical to -key. 777 cot-self-verify-backward: the Self-Verification backward checking — k sampled answers are normalized via str(float(x)) and first-seen deduped into candidates; for each candidate the question text (commas become periods first, truncated at the last period) yields all numbers via findall(r'-?\d+\.?\d*') and blanks them into 'X' one at a time (character-list slice assignment; the official number_find flag is missing so every segment containing the number is replaced; replace('..','.') fixes the empty-tail double period; **at most the first 3 numbers**; period-spanning numbers and trailing-dot numbers match no segment so no blanking happens — the official trap); the declarative cache replaces the **last occurrence of answers[0]** via reverse-find splicing (≡rfind) or falls back to the template (an empty cache reaches the same fallback through the else branch); verifier verdicts are scored against the original blanked number with **bidirectional independent try-float** (the numeric verifier, not the TF one), candidate totals are argmaxed with **ties to the earliest**, and is_true is judged against the normalized GT; the verdict pool is flat-indexed by a_idx*3+d (tail slots for candidates with fewer than 3 subquestions are dead), and a single candidate takes scores={0:1} with no verification. 778 cot-rot-recursion-stack: the RoT recursive solving sequence compilation — an arithmetic problem is compiled under the rot paradigm into a single seq2seq training sequence: the tokenizer splits by '\\c' escapes and '<...>' special tokens (an unterminated run is dropped entirely, the empty '<>' is a legal token); x starts at tokenize(question) with y shifted one behind; each thought is injected — x takes the subquestion and sub-answer tokens, y takes the subquestion tokens + '<THINK>' plus len(sub-answer)-1 '<PAD>'s, and label takes len(subquestion)+1 Ts and len(subanswer)-1 PADs; the three-stream length invariant len(x)==len(y)==len(label) holds via "base: -1 → each thought: +1 → answer: +1"; a tail thought replaces the first token with '<TAIL>' on both x and y and emits neither the sub-answer nor the main answer (no A in label, y ends with '<THINK>'), and a non-tail after a tail is invalid; Compare recurses only on equal digit counts with int(str[1:]) dropping the leading zero (rest of 105 is 5) and gives zero thoughts across differing digit counts; Add's carry chain appends (l//10,1) before incrementing (the (0,1) thought still occurs when l_rest=0, as in 9+91) and takes the third segment only when l_rest>0 and r_rest>0; Mul's double base (×0/×1 and the times table) plus the decomposition branch (r=10 takes the >=10 branch with a zero r%10 partial product) plus the tail addition (a2*10, a1) with a2 in the high part; ProbGraph expands DFS pre-order deduped by (problem,args) node (duplicates expand their subtree only at first occurrence), while the cot paradigm flattens pre-order **without dedup** and a tail emits only its question, never an answer. 779 cot-cumulative-verified: the Cumulative Reasoning Game24 verified cumulative-state ledger — the proposer/validity/verifier LLM outputs are all explicit inputs (a rounds script); each round starts from a = remaining's first line through four gates (next.strip() containing any char outside [^0-9+\-*/.(),=\s] skips; next.strip() or remaining.strip() without \\S skips; judgement=='Invalid' skips — only Invalid blocks), the verifier's 'sure' reconstructs the solution path along parent links ([equation first line, next+' (left a)', each ancestor step with ' (left state)'], reversed overall) and returns (True, round index, steps) immediately, 'likely' admits via the five-step bookkeeping only when the new state a is not in records (forbidden[chosen] append, forbidden[a]=[], records append, parent[a]=chosen, last_step[a]=next.strip()), an a already in records **drops the whole round silently** (forbidden not appended either), other verdicts do nothing, and any in-round exception silently skips the round (official try/except continue); the loop bound trycnt truncates rounds (fewer rounds finish early) and failure returns (False, trycnt, []) with **the marker being trycnt itself**; the sampling distribution is two-phase — for i < 1/2*trycnt (**float division**, odd trycnt rounds the midpoint down) the root is biased with p[0]=0.5 and the rest 0.5/(n-1), n=1 is [1.0] directly, otherwise uniform 1/n; the official success path returns the expand LLM's merged output, this port returns the deterministic reconstruction payload steps. 780 cot-star-rationalize: STaR's bootstrapping rationalization ledger (all LLM outputs explicit) — extract: cqa takes the first line clipped of endoftext then the [-3] char (len<3 raises IndexError silently skipped, total increments before the try), gsm truncates at the first #### line (saves the unstripped truncation) and takes split('####')[-1].strip() (no #### gives an empty prediction, never saved), arithmetic does whole-line equality membership tests on the line list (endoftext index -1 is the prediction line, index 0 -> negative index takes the last line; </scratch> +1==len skips; otherwise direct and len>1 -> 1 else 0); correct samples (both lower()) write back base + extraction intermediate + endoftext with per-class buckets; score returns int 0 when total==0; context assembles the three dataset formats (cqa (CORRECT) marks, gsm ' (answer)', arithmetic Target: adjacent split pairs joined as seg+'Target:', direct keeps the post-</scratch> half, hint appends the next segment's 5th-from-last line); eval batches by eval_batch_size (a short trailing batch is never evaluated), arithmetic overwrites the few-shot with base.split('\n\n')[:-1], a p_show_hint_save hit saves the hinted base, few_shot_train prepends train_prompts (arithmetic raises NotImplementedError immediately), misses join the pool via p_rationalization (short-circuit, coins only for misses), and a full pool flushes immediately renamed key+'_r' into its own bucket under hint contexts with the remainder kept (carry-over). 781 cot-cocogen-code-graph-convert: CoCoGen's code-to-graph bidirectional parsing ledger (the official repo has no standalone graph validator; source-corrected todos description) — parse: get_nodes strips one character from each end of graph_str[1:-1] (regardless of parentheses), splits on )(' ; segments without ';' are skipped, segments with ';' must split into exactly 3 parts (else unpack ValueError), each part stripped, nodes in first-appearance order (from before to), and when to is already in from_to_dict[from] neither ledger appends (a second from->to edge is dropped entirely); to_python emits the fixed skeleton (class ExplanationDAG/__init__/belief= argument= stance= **interpolated verbatim without escaping**/# create a DAG to {stance} belief using argument comment; prompt_part_only returns here), writes the root nodes (in-degree 0, node-addition order) as a quoted begin line, then emits add_edge("from","rel","to") per edge in from_to_typed dict order; to_graph extracts the three fields via regex belief = "(.*?)" (missing -> AttributeError), and per add_edge line takes split("(")[1] (content after a '(' inside the target is lost), chops the last char with [:-1], splits on ', "' into exactly 3 parts (a double space mismatches -> IndexError), strips and joins (source; rel; target), then the unified cleanup: delete all '"', ';' -> '; ', '  ' -> ' ' (**single-pass** replace, three spaces fold by one level only); roots replicates GraphAlgos.root_nodes over to_nx_graph — in-degree 0 in node-addition order, **a src with empty dests never enters the graph**, pure cycle []; case covers three functions — camel strips a trailing period then joins per-token capitalize (**lowercasing the rest**), snake strips a trailing period + re.sub(r'[\\s\\W]', '_') + lower + strip (whitespace only; the trailing _ produced by a stripped period survives), desnake splits on '_' and joins with spaces; empty strings raise IndexError at camel/snake's title[-1].

description: OCR 与文档解析的可转写机制：识别头 CTC greedy 解码与 blank 分隔 collapse、文档 bbox 归一化与 2D 位置索引、评测侧逐行归一化编辑距离账、整页截图的可变宽高比 patch 网格预算、表格结构 token 的 cell 网格展开、llama.cpp mtmd 的多模态批调度、PP-Structure 双栏阅读顺序状态机、olmOCR 图片元素 union-find 容差合并等纯账本（真图/编码器不出，坐标、矩阵与字符串全入参）。 PaddleOCR DB 后处理单框账：box_score_fast 的 bbox floor/ceil/clip 与 fillPoly 坐标 astype 向零截断两套口径共存（闭矩形含右下边界、全零 mask 均值 0.0）、unclip 距离 = |shoelace|×ratio/闭合周长、pyclipper 输入截断/输出 round-half-away 的整数语义、min_size 与 min_size+2 双尺寸门与门序、dest 缩放银行家舍入与双界 clip。 DeepSeek-OCR 五档动态分辨率与 tile 账：小图门 and 一维越界即切与 <= 恰等、ratio 集合 i/j 上界是循环变量 n 的构造 quirk、最近匹配严格 < 先到先得与 diff 平分的 area 抢位（阈值随 tile 数增大）、resize 直接拉伸非等比与行优先 tile box、token 序列账全局 (qb+1)·qb+1 与局部 (q·nw+1)·q·nh（行内跨 tile 连排共享行末 sep）及与 README 编码器口径的差异。 MinerU 检测框区间与行聚合账：bbox 在 y/x 轴的 max(0,...) 钳位重叠比例门限（严格 >、退化框除零保护，默认 0.8 与 lines.py 固定 0.6 双口径）、闭区间严格 < 合并使相邻区间并段与 ±1 离散整数点遮罩裁除、span 行聚合的 interline 降级 / 有效 span 分母 / h/w>2 与 vertical/valid>0.8 双严格门 / 竖排按 bbox[2] 降序与 x 轴分组 / 横排按 bbox[1] 升序与 y 轴分组 / 特殊类型双向或强制断行 / 行内异键排序与外接矩形，以及检测四点框 calculate_is_angle 的左右平均高度带内判定、points_to_bbox 取 p1.x/p1.y/p2.x/p3.y、宽高比严格 > 4 触发同行 merge_overlapping_spans（内部亦严格 < 判 x 相接）与 angle 框末尾原样追加。
description_en: Transcribable mechanisms from OCR and document parsing: the recognition head's CTC greedy decoding with blank-separator collapse, document bbox normalization and 2D position indexing, per-line normalized edit distance metrics, the variable aspect-ratio patch grid budget for full-page screenshots, table structure token cell-grid expansion, llama.cpp mtmd multimodal batch scheduling, the PP-Structure two-column reading-order state machine, and olmOCR's union-find image-element tolerance merging, as pure ledgers (no real images or encoders; coordinates, matrices and strings are explicit inputs). The PaddleOCR DB postprocess single-box ledger: box_score_fast's floor/ceil/clip bbox coexisting with fillPoly's truncate-toward-zero rasterization (closed rectangle including right/bottom edges, all-zero mask mean of 0.0), the unclip distance of |shoelace|×ratio over the closed perimeter, pyclipper's integer semantics of truncated inputs and round-half-away outputs, the min_size and min_size+2 size gates with their ordering, and dest rescaling's banker's rounding with two-sided clipping. The DeepSeek-OCR five-mode dynamic resolution and tile ledger: the small-image and-gate where a single overflowing dimension triggers tiling and <= passes exactly at the bound, the ratio-set quirk whose i/j bound is the loop variable n, the closest match's strict < first-come-first-served with area stealing on diff ties (the threshold growing with tile count), direct non-aspect-preserving resize with row-major tile boxes, and the token sequence ledger of global (qb+1)·qb+1 plus local (q·nw+1)·q·nh (tiles sharing a row-end sep) versus the README's pure-encoder accounting. The MinerU detection-box interval and line-grouping ledger: the y/x overlap-ratio gate with a max(0,...) clamp (strict >, degenerate-box zero-division guard, dual conventions of default 0.8 and lines.py's fixed 0.6), closed-interval merging under a strict < that joins adjacent intervals plus ±1 discrete integer-point mask exclusion, span-to-line grouping with interline downgrade / valid-span denominator / dual strict gates of h/w>2 and vertical/valid>0.8 / vertical lines keyed by bbox[2] descending with x-axis grouping / horizontal lines keyed by bbox[1] ascending with y-axis grouping / bidirectional-OR special-type breaks / distinct inner sort keys and bounding rectangles, plus calculate_is_angle's averaged left/right side height band test, points_to_bbox taking p1.x/p1.y/p2.x/p3.y, an aspect ratio strictly > 4 triggering merge_overlapping_spans within a line (itself using a strict < on x adjacency), and angle boxes appended unchanged at the end.

description: 语音识别系统的可转写机制：CTC greedy 解码、声学谱增强段掩蔽、CIF integrate-and-fire 发射状态机、Whisper 30s 窗口 seek 推进等纯账本（真音频/编码器不出，谱、权重与 token 流全入参）。 WhisperX 强制对齐账：trellis DP 的列 0 尾部 +inf 强制收尾填充、回溯严格大于的平分留 blank 与两域混用（log 域 DP + 概率域帧分）、merge_repeats 帧均与 merge_words 长度加权两套聚合、separator 三态不产空词、T<N 必返 None 的不变量。 Whisper 语言 ID 账：非语言位 -inf 抑制后 softmax 的语言集合重归一化（raw 对照）、argmax 与 max(probs) 两套平分规则、单条/批双路解包、transcribe 只跑首个 30s 窗的检测策略与显式 language 跳过。 FunASR FSMN-VAD 端点检测决策核账：帧判定的概率门/SNR 门双门与噪声 EMA 窄更新面（门失败不更新、跨段延续）、滑窗状态机环形未满不遗忘与双阈值翻转、thresh=max_end_silence-speech_to_sil 相减 quirk、起点回退与终点回退 54 帧、假段与 single 终态跳帧、max_time_out 仅 Speech2Speech 置位。 NeMo TDT token-and-duration 贪心解码账：blank 的 duration 强制 ≥1 与非 blank 同样按 duration 跳帧的 TDT/RNN-T 本质差异（跳出句末发射仍有效）、发射时间戳在跳帧前快照、max_symbols 强制 blank 只进 1 帧忽略 duration、非 blank duration=0 的域约束与官方无防护）、Moonshine 上下文偏置 Trie 走账（前缀 Trie 注册与 ▁ 词首双变体、深度对数爬坡 boost(1+ln depth)、重叠提案去重取 max、root 常驻走账与弃路回落），以及 Moonshine 流式投机验证状态账（稳定帧 lookahead、16×depth 编码滑窗、6.5 tok/s 解码预算、cross-KV 生命周期失效、greedy 验证分歧回退与续解码），以及 Zipformer 流式缓存状态账（滚动左上下文缓存、as_strided 相对位置对齐、门控卷积、chunk 级因果卷积分解与整除恒等），以及 SenseVoice 的 rich-token 多任务前缀账（4 帧 rich 前缀 query 查 16 行小 embed 表、Kaldi 风格 LabelSmoothing rich CE、CTC greedy 折叠滤 blank、ban_emo_unk 的 -inf 屏蔽、内容 CTC 的 [4, L) 偏移窗），以及 Qwen3-ASR AuT 的分块编码器账（per-chunk 8× 下采样长度 %100/×13 硬编码、分块计划整除回落满窗、batch 串切打包、per-chunk 位置编码与 mask 展平、cu_seqlens 窗口分窗、块对角注意力段间隔离），以及 Qwen3-ForcedAligner 的 NAR 时间戳账（CJK 逐字分词与双 <timestamp> 占位、仅占位位 argmax × segment_time、最长非降 LIS 单调修复（邻值择一 / 线性插值 / int 截断）、成对词 span 秒换算）。
description_en: Transcribable mechanisms from speech recognition: CTC greedy decoding, spectral augmentation band masking, the CIF integrate-and-fire emission state machine, and Whisper's 30s window seek loop, as pure ledgers (no real audio or encoders; spectrograms, weights and token streams are explicit inputs). The WhisperX forced-alignment ledger: the column-0 tail +inf forced-completion fill, strict-greater backtracking ties that stay on blank with mixed log/probability domains, the frame-mean versus length-weighted two-aggregator split between merge_repeats and merge_words, separator three-state empty-word guards, and the ok-equals-(T>=N) invariant. The Whisper language-ID ledger: post-suppression softmax renormalization over the language set (with the raw control), the two disagreeing tie rules of argmax and max(probs), single/batch dual-path unwrapping, and the transcribe policy of detecting only on the first 30s window with explicit-language skip. The FunASR FSMN-VAD endpoint decision-core ledger: the probability/SNR dual gate with the noise EMA's narrow update surface (gate failures leave it untouched, persisting across segments), the sliding-window machine's no-forget-while-unfilled ring and dual-threshold flips, the max_end_silence-speech_to_sil subtraction quirk, 54-frame start/end lookbacks, fake segments and single-mode terminal skipping, and max_time_out set only in the Speech2Speech branch. The NeMo TDT token-and-duration greedy decoding ledger: blank's forced duration >= 1 versus non-blanks skipping frames by duration as the essential TDT/RNN-T difference (an emission that jumps past the end still counts), emission timestamps snapshotted before the jump, max_symbols forced blanks advancing exactly 1 frame and ignoring duration, and the non-blank zero-duration domain constraint where the official code has no protection), Moonshine's context biaser trie walk (prefix trie registration with ▁ word-start dual variants, the logarithmic depth ramp boost(1+ln depth), overlapping proposals deduped to the max, and the always-active-root walk that falls back on mismatch), plus Moonshine's streaming speculative-verification state ledger (stable-frame lookahead, 16×depth encoder window, 6.5 tok/s decode budget, cross-KV lifetime invalidation, and greedy-verification divergence rewind with continuation), plus Zipformer's streaming cache ledger (rolling left context, as_strided relative-position alignment, gated convolution, and the chunk-causal convolution decomposition with its divisibility identity), plus SenseVoice's rich-token multi-task prefix ledger (a 4-frame rich-prefix query indexing a 16-row small embed table, Kaldi-style LabelSmoothing rich CE, CTC greedy folding with blank filtering, ban_emo_unk's -inf masking, and the content CTC's [4, L) offset window), plus Qwen3-ASR AuT's chunked-encoder ledger (per-chunk 8× downsampling lengths with hard-coded %100/×13, divisible-tail fallback to a full window in the chunk plan, batch concatenate-then-split packing, per-chunk position encoding with mask flattening, cu_seqlens windowing, and cross-segment-isolated block-diagonal attention), plus Qwen3-ForcedAligner's NAR timestamp ledger (CJK character-wise tokenization with paired <timestamp> placeholders, placeholder-only argmax times segment_time, longest non-decreasing LIS monotonic repair with neighbor-choice / linear interpolation / int truncation, and paired word-span conversion to seconds).

name: 语音合成合集
description: TTS 系统的可转写机制：FastSpeech2 方差适配器时长链与展开账、中文 TN 数字读法规引擎等纯账本（真音频/声学模型不出，predictor 输出与规则串全入参）。 另有 IndexTTS-2：文本 token 按标点优先级递归分段（逗号/连字符递归、超长硬切、跨段 total_token 合并状态机）、生成 codes 里连续静音 token 收缩（整行计数含 stop 之后、最多留 10、batch 级重拼与 max_len 切齐）、以及生成后 code_lens 截 stop 与 int(code_len × 1.72) 的 mel 帧账。
description_en: Transcribable mechanisms from TTS systems: the FastSpeech2 variance adaptor duration chain and expansion ledger, and the Chinese TN number verbalization rule engine, as pure ledgers (no real audio or acoustic models; predictor outputs and rule strings are explicit inputs). Also IndexTTS-2: recursive text-token segmentation by punctuation priority (comma/hyphen recursion, over-length hard cut, cross-segment total_token merge state machine), shrinking consecutive silence tokens in generated codes (whole-row count including after stop, at most 10 kept, batch-level rebuild and max_len clipping), and the post-generation mel-frame ledger of code_lens cut at stop and int(code_len * 1.72).

name: 全模态合集
description: 全栈语音-文本模型的可转写机制：Thinker-Talker 隐态逐帧回灌与 1:1 配比、语音-文本交错流的渐进分块解析、Moshi 双流 acoustic delay 与覆盖链等纯账本（真模型不出，隐态与 token 流全入参）。另收录 voice2 全双工 barge-in 控制面账（28 条状态转移表与 STOPPED no-exit / invalid_transition / floor_blocked 三类拒绝、floor 五动作与 request_agent_floor 不传 turn_id、打断去抖首个触发胜出与 interrupted/floor/state 三连锁、playback_is_allowed 五级优先级与 INV1 强制修复 / INV2 仅审计、round(4) 延迟段与 int(*1000) 毫秒账、stale guard 与只丢本 turn 排队项的已合成 chunk 丢弃账）。
description_en: Transcribable mechanisms from full-duplex speech-text models: the thinker-talker frame-by-frame hidden-state replay at a 1:1 ratio, progressive chunking of interleaved speech-text streams, and Moshi's dual-stream acoustic delay with its overwrite chain, as pure ledgers (no real models; hidden states and token streams are explicit inputs). Plus voice2's full-duplex barge-in control-plane ledger (28-entry transition table with three rejection classes, five floor actions and request_agent_floor's omitted turn_id, debounced interrupt with first-trigger-wins and the interrupted/floor/state chain, five-level playback_is_allowed priority with INV1 forced repair / INV2 audit, round(4) spans and int(*1000) millisecond ledger, stale guard and the synthesized-chunk discard ledger that drops only the current turn's queued items).
